#!/bin/bash
#
# ⬢ Synapse - Verification Script v2.7.0
#
# Comprehensive verification tool for the Synapse project.
# Run before committing to ensure all checks pass.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/verify.sh              # Full verification (default)
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --quick      # Skip build, fast tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --backend    # Backend tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --frontend   # Frontend tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --unit       # Unit tests only (fastest)
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --integration # Integration tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --lint       # Lint/architecture tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --help       # Show help
#

# Get the directory where this script is located
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

# Colors
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
CYAN='\033[0;36m'
MAGENTA='\033[0;35m'
BOLD='\033[1m'
DIM='\033[2m'
NC='\033[0m'

# Default modes
RUN_BACKEND=true
RUN_FRONTEND=true
RUN_TYPES=true
RUN_BUILD=true
QUICK_MODE=false
VERBOSE=false

# Test filters
PYTEST_MARKERS=""
PYTEST_PATHS="tests/"

# ============================================================================
# Help
# ============================================================================

show_help() {
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}⬢ Synapse Verification Script${NC}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Usage:${NC}"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh [OPTIONS]"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Options:${NC}"
    echo "  --help, -h        Show this help message"
    echo "  --quick, -q       Quick mode: skip build, exclude slow tests"
    echo "  --verbose, -v     Verbose output (show all test details)"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Scope Options:${NC}"
    echo "  --backend, -b     Run only backend (Python) tests"
    echo "  --frontend, -f    Run only frontend (TypeScript) tests"
    echo "  --all, -a         Run all checks (default)"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Backend Test Filters:${NC}"
    echo "  --unit            Run only unit tests (tests/unit/)"
    echo "  --integration     Run only integration tests (tests/integration/)"
    echo "  --store           Run only store tests (tests/store/)"
    echo "  --lint            Run only lint/architecture tests (tests/lint/)"
    echo "  --no-slow         Exclude tests marked @pytest.mark.slow"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Examples:${NC}"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh                    # Full verification"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --quick            # Fast verification"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --backend --unit   # Only Python unit tests"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh -b --no-slow       # Backend without slow tests"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --lint             # Architecture checks only"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Test Structure:${NC}"
    echo "  tests/"
    echo "  ├── unit/           # Fast, isolated tests"
    echo "  │   ├── core/       # src/core/ tests"
    echo "  │   ├── clients/    # src/clients/ tests"
    echo "  │   └── utils/      # src/utils/ tests"
    echo "  ├── store/          # Store/API tests"
    echo "  ├── integration/    # Multi-component tests"
    echo "  └── lint/           # Architecture enforcement"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Pytest Markers:${NC}"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.slow         # Long-running tests"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.integration  # Require multiple components"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.civitai      # Civitai API related"
    echo ""
}

# ============================================================================
# Parse Arguments
# ============================================================================

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --help|-h)
            show_help
            exit 0
            ;;
        --quick|-q)
            QUICK_MODE=true
            RUN_BUILD=false
            PYTEST_MARKERS="not slow"
            shift
            ;;
        --verbose|-v)
            VERBOSE=true
            shift
            ;;
        --backend|-b)
            RUN_BACKEND=true
            RUN_FRONTEND=false
            RUN_TYPES=false
            RUN_BUILD=false
            shift
            ;;
        --frontend|-f)
            RUN_BACKEND=false
            RUN_FRONTEND=true
            RUN_TYPES=true
            RUN_BUILD=true
            shift
            ;;
        --all|-a)
            RUN_BACKEND=true
            RUN_FRONTEND=true
            RUN_TYPES=true
            RUN_BUILD=true
            shift
            ;;
        --unit)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/unit/"
            shift
            ;;
        --integration)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/integration/"
            shift
            ;;
        --store)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/store/"
            shift
            ;;
        --lint)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/lint/"
            shift
            ;;
        --no-slow)
            if [ -z "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
                PYTEST_MARKERS="not slow"
            else
                PYTEST_MARKERS="$PYTEST_MARKERS and not slow"
            fi
            shift
            ;;
        *)
            echo -e "${RED}Unknown option: $1${NC}"
            echo "Use --help for usage information"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# ============================================================================
# Header
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${MAGENTA}"
echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║                                                                    ║"
echo "║   ⬢ Synapse - Verification Script v2.7.0                          ║"
echo "║                                                                    ║"
echo "╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo -e "${NC}"
echo -e "${CYAN}Project root: $PROJECT_ROOT${NC}"

# Show active modes
echo -e "${DIM}Modes: backend=$RUN_BACKEND frontend=$RUN_FRONTEND build=$RUN_BUILD${NC}"
if [ "$QUICK_MODE" == true ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Quick mode enabled${NC}"
fi
if [ -n "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
    echo -e "${DIM}Pytest markers: $PYTEST_MARKERS${NC}"
fi
if [ "$PYTEST_PATHS" != "tests/" ]; then
    echo -e "${DIM}Test path: $PYTEST_PATHS${NC}"
fi
echo ""

FAILED=0
WARNINGS=0
STEP=0
TOTAL_STEPS=0

# Calculate total steps
[ "$RUN_BACKEND" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 2))  # env + tests
[ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 2)) # env + tests
[ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 1))
[ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 1))

# ============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# ============================================================================

check_passed() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}  ✓ $1${NC}"
}

check_failed() {
    echo -e "${RED}  ✗ $1${NC}"
    FAILED=1
}

check_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}  ! $1${NC}"
    WARNINGS=$((WARNINGS + 1))
}

check_skipped() {
    echo -e "${DIM}  ○ $1 (skipped)${NC}"
}

next_step() {
    STEP=$((STEP + 1))
    echo -e "${BOLD}[$STEP/$TOTAL_STEPS] $1${NC}"
}

# ============================================================================
# Backend Checks
# ============================================================================

if [ "$RUN_BACKEND" == true ]; then

    # 1. Python Environment
    next_step "Checking Python Environment"

    # Find Python - prefer uv, then venv, then system
    if command -v uv &> /dev/null; then
        PYTHON_CMD="uv run python"
        PYTEST_CMD="uv run pytest"
        check_passed "Using uv (recommended)"
    elif [ -f ".venv/bin/python" ]; then
        PYTHON_CMD=".venv/bin/python"
        PYTEST_CMD=".venv/bin/pytest"
        check_passed "Using virtual environment: .venv"
    elif command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
        PYTHON_CMD="python3"
        PYTEST_CMD="python3 -m pytest"
        check_warning "Using system Python (consider using uv or .venv)"
    else
        check_failed "Python not found"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check pytest is available
    if $PYTEST_CMD --version &> /dev/null; then
        check_passed "pytest available"
    else
        check_failed "pytest not installed"
    fi
    echo ""

    # 2. Backend Tests
    next_step "Running Backend Tests"

    # Build pytest command
    PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_PATHS --tb=short"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -v"
    else
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -q"
    fi

    if [ -n "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -m \"$PYTEST_MARKERS\""
    fi

    echo -e "${DIM}Running: pytest $PYTEST_ARGS${NC}"

    if eval "$PYTEST_CMD $PYTEST_ARGS"; then
        check_passed "Backend tests passed"
    else
        check_failed "Backend tests FAILED"
    fi
    echo ""
fi

# ============================================================================
# Frontend Checks
# ============================================================================

if [ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ] || [ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ] || [ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ]; then

    if [ ! -d "apps/web" ]; then
        check_failed "Frontend directory not found: apps/web"
        exit 1
    fi

    cd apps/web

    # Check package manager
    if command -v pnpm &> /dev/null; then
        PKG_MANAGER="pnpm"
    elif command -v npm &> /dev/null; then
        PKG_MANAGER="npm"
    else
        check_failed "No package manager found (pnpm or npm)"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check node_modules
    if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Installing dependencies...${NC}"
        $PKG_MANAGER install --silent
    fi
fi

if [ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ]; then

    # 3. Frontend Environment
    next_step "Checking Frontend Environment"
    check_passed "Using $PKG_MANAGER"
    check_passed "node_modules ready"
    echo ""

    # 4. Frontend Tests
    next_step "Running Frontend Tests"

    # Run tests in CI mode (not watch mode)
    if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" == "pnpm" ]; then
        TEST_CMD="$PKG_MANAGER test --run"
    else
        TEST_CMD="$PKG_MANAGER test -- --run"
    fi

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if $TEST_CMD; then
            check_passed "Frontend tests passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend tests FAILED"
        fi
    else
        if $TEST_CMD > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            check_passed "Frontend tests passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend tests FAILED"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            $TEST_CMD
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

if [ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ]; then

    # 5. TypeScript Type Check
    next_step "TypeScript Type Check"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if npx tsc --noEmit; then
            check_passed "TypeScript types OK"
        else
            check_failed "TypeScript type errors found"
        fi
    else
        if npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 > /dev/null; then
            check_passed "TypeScript types OK"
        else
            check_failed "TypeScript type errors found"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            npx tsc --noEmit
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

if [ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ]; then

    # 6. Frontend Build
    next_step "Building Frontend"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if $PKG_MANAGER run build; then
            check_passed "Frontend build passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend build FAILED"
        fi
    else
        if $PKG_MANAGER run build > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            check_passed "Frontend build passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend build FAILED"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            $PKG_MANAGER run build
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

# ============================================================================
# Summary
# ============================================================================

echo ""
echo -e "${MAGENTA}╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗${NC}"
if [ "$FAILED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$WARNINGS" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}║  ✓ All checks passed! Ready to commit.                             ║${NC}"
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}║  ✓ Checks passed with $WARNINGS warning(s). Review above.              ║${NC}"
    fi
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}║  ✗ Some checks FAILED. Please fix before committing.               ║${NC}"
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝${NC}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${CYAN}Tip: Use --verbose for detailed output${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

#   ./scripts/verify.sh --unit       # Unit tests only (fastest)
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --integration # Integration tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --lint       # Lint/architecture tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --help       # Show help
#

# Get the directory where this script is located
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

# Colors
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
CYAN='\033[0;36m'
MAGENTA='\033[0;35m'
BOLD='\033[1m'
DIM='\033[2m'
NC='\033[0m'

# Default modes
RUN_BACKEND=true
RUN_FRONTEND=true
RUN_TYPES=true
RUN_BUILD=true
QUICK_MODE=false
VERBOSE=false

# Test filters
PYTEST_MARKERS=""
PYTEST_PATHS="tests/"

# ============================================================================
# Help
# ============================================================================

show_help() {
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}⬢ Synapse Verification Script${NC}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Usage:${NC}"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh [OPTIONS]"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Options:${NC}"
    echo "  --help, -h        Show this help message"
    echo "  --quick, -q       Quick mode: skip build, exclude slow tests"
    echo "  --verbose, -v     Verbose output (show all test details)"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Scope Options:${NC}"
    echo "  --backend, -b     Run only backend (Python) tests"
    echo "  --frontend, -f    Run only frontend (TypeScript) tests"
    echo "  --all, -a         Run all checks (default)"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Backend Test Filters:${NC}"
    echo "  --unit            Run only unit tests (tests/unit/)"
    echo "  --integration     Run only integration tests (tests/integration/)"
    echo "  --store           Run only store tests (tests/store/)"
    echo "  --lint            Run only lint/architecture tests (tests/lint/)"
    echo "  --smoke           Run offline smoke tests (CDN/proxy pipeline)"
    echo "  --smoke-live      Run all smoke tests including live CDN"
    echo "  --no-slow         Exclude tests marked @pytest.mark.slow"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Examples:${NC}"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh                    # Full verification"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --quick            # Fast verification"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --backend --unit   # Only Python unit tests"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh -b --no-slow       # Backend without slow tests"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --lint             # Architecture checks only"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Test Structure:${NC}"
    echo "  tests/"
    echo "  ├── unit/           # Fast, isolated tests"
    echo "  │   ├── core/       # src/core/ tests"
    echo "  │   ├── clients/    # src/clients/ tests"
    echo "  │   └── utils/      # src/utils/ tests"
    echo "  ├── store/          # Store/API tests"
    echo "  ├── integration/    # Multi-component tests"
    echo "  └── lint/           # Architecture enforcement"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Pytest Markers:${NC}"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.slow         # Long-running tests"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.integration  # Require multiple components"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.civitai      # Civitai API related"
    echo ""
}

# ============================================================================
# Parse Arguments
# ============================================================================

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --help|-h)
            show_help
            exit 0
            ;;
        --quick|-q)
            QUICK_MODE=true
            RUN_BUILD=false
            PYTEST_MARKERS="not slow"
            shift
            ;;
        --verbose|-v)
            VERBOSE=true
            shift
            ;;
        --backend|-b)
            RUN_BACKEND=true
            RUN_FRONTEND=false
            RUN_TYPES=false
            RUN_BUILD=false
            shift
            ;;
        --frontend|-f)
            RUN_BACKEND=false
            RUN_FRONTEND=true
            RUN_TYPES=true
            RUN_BUILD=true
            shift
            ;;
        --all|-a)
            RUN_BACKEND=true
            RUN_FRONTEND=true
            RUN_TYPES=true
            RUN_BUILD=true
            shift
            ;;
        --unit)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/unit/"
            shift
            ;;
        --integration)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/integration/"
            shift
            ;;
        --store)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/store/"
            shift
            ;;
        --lint)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/lint/"
            shift
            ;;
        --no-slow)
            if [ -z "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
                PYTEST_MARKERS="not slow"
            else
                PYTEST_MARKERS="$PYTEST_MARKERS and not slow"
            fi
            shift
            ;;
        *)
            echo -e "${RED}Unknown option: $1${NC}"
            echo "Use --help for usage information"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# ============================================================================
# Header
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${MAGENTA}"
echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║                                                                    ║"
echo "║   ⬢ Synapse - Verification Script v2.7.0                          ║"
echo "║                                                                    ║"
echo "╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo -e "${NC}"
echo -e "${CYAN}Project root: $PROJECT_ROOT${NC}"

# Show active modes
echo -e "${DIM}Modes: backend=$RUN_BACKEND frontend=$RUN_FRONTEND build=$RUN_BUILD${NC}"
if [ "$QUICK_MODE" == true ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Quick mode enabled${NC}"
fi
if [ -n "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
    echo -e "${DIM}Pytest markers: $PYTEST_MARKERS${NC}"
fi
if [ "$PYTEST_PATHS" != "tests/" ]; then
    echo -e "${DIM}Test path: $PYTEST_PATHS${NC}"
fi
echo ""

FAILED=0
WARNINGS=0
STEP=0
TOTAL_STEPS=0

# Calculate total steps
[ "$RUN_BACKEND" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 2))  # env + tests
[ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 2)) # env + tests
[ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 1))
[ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 1))

# ============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# ============================================================================

check_passed() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}  ✓ $1${NC}"
}

check_failed() {
    echo -e "${RED}  ✗ $1${NC}"
    FAILED=1
}

check_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}  ! $1${NC}"
    WARNINGS=$((WARNINGS + 1))
}

check_skipped() {
    echo -e "${DIM}  ○ $1 (skipped)${NC}"
}

next_step() {
    STEP=$((STEP + 1))
    echo -e "${BOLD}[$STEP/$TOTAL_STEPS] $1${NC}"
}

# ============================================================================
# Backend Checks
# ============================================================================

if [ "$RUN_BACKEND" == true ]; then

    # 1. Python Environment
    next_step "Checking Python Environment"

    # Find Python - prefer uv, then venv, then system
    if command -v uv &> /dev/null; then
        PYTHON_CMD="uv run python"
        PYTEST_CMD="uv run pytest"
        check_passed "Using uv (recommended)"
    elif [ -f ".venv/bin/python" ]; then
        PYTHON_CMD=".venv/bin/python"
        PYTEST_CMD=".venv/bin/pytest"
        check_passed "Using virtual environment: .venv"
    elif command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
        PYTHON_CMD="python3"
        PYTEST_CMD="python3 -m pytest"
        check_warning "Using system Python (consider using uv or .venv)"
    else
        check_failed "Python not found"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check pytest is available
    if $PYTEST_CMD --version &> /dev/null; then
        check_passed "pytest available"
    else
        check_failed "pytest not installed"
    fi
    echo ""

    # 2. Backend Tests
    next_step "Running Backend Tests"

    # Build pytest command
    PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_PATHS --tb=short"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -v"
    else
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -q"
    fi

    if [ -n "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -m \"$PYTEST_MARKERS\""
    fi

    echo -e "${DIM}Running: pytest $PYTEST_ARGS${NC}"

    if eval "$PYTEST_CMD $PYTEST_ARGS"; then
        check_passed "Backend tests passed"
    else
        check_failed "Backend tests FAILED"
    fi
    echo ""
fi

# ============================================================================
# Frontend Checks
# ============================================================================

if [ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ] || [ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ] || [ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ]; then

    if [ ! -d "apps/web" ]; then
        check_failed "Frontend directory not found: apps/web"
        exit 1
    fi

    cd apps/web

    # Check package manager
    if command -v pnpm &> /dev/null; then
        PKG_MANAGER="pnpm"
    elif command -v npm &> /dev/null; then
        PKG_MANAGER="npm"
    else
        check_failed "No package manager found (pnpm or npm)"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check node_modules
    if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Installing dependencies...${NC}"
        $PKG_MANAGER install --silent
    fi
fi

if [ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ]; then

    # 3. Frontend Environment
    next_step "Checking Frontend Environment"
    check_passed "Using $PKG_MANAGER"
    check_passed "node_modules ready"
    echo ""

    # 4. Frontend Tests
    next_step "Running Frontend Tests"

    # Run tests in CI mode (not watch mode)
    if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" == "pnpm" ]; then
        TEST_CMD="$PKG_MANAGER test --run"
    else
        TEST_CMD="$PKG_MANAGER test -- --run"
    fi

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if $TEST_CMD; then
            check_passed "Frontend tests passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend tests FAILED"
        fi
    else
        if $TEST_CMD > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            check_passed "Frontend tests passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend tests FAILED"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            $TEST_CMD
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

if [ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ]; then

    # 5. TypeScript Type Check
    next_step "TypeScript Type Check"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if npx tsc --noEmit; then
            check_passed "TypeScript types OK"
        else
            check_failed "TypeScript type errors found"
        fi
    else
        if npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 > /dev/null; then
            check_passed "TypeScript types OK"
        else
            check_failed "TypeScript type errors found"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            npx tsc --noEmit
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

if [ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ]; then

    # 6. Frontend Build
    next_step "Building Frontend"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if $PKG_MANAGER run build; then
            check_passed "Frontend build passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend build FAILED"
        fi
    else
        if $PKG_MANAGER run build > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            check_passed "Frontend build passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend build FAILED"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            $PKG_MANAGER run build
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

# ============================================================================
# Summary
# ============================================================================

echo ""
echo -e "${MAGENTA}╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗${NC}"
if [ "$FAILED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$WARNINGS" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}║  ✓ All checks passed! Ready to commit.                             ║${NC}"
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}║  ✓ Checks passed with $WARNINGS warning(s). Review above.              ║${NC}"
    fi
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}║  ✗ Some checks FAILED. Please fix before committing.               ║${NC}"
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝${NC}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${CYAN}Tip: Use --verbose for detailed output${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash
#
# ⬢ Synapse - Verification Script v2.7.0
#
# Comprehensive verification tool for the Synapse project.
# Run before committing to ensure all checks pass.
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/verify.sh              # Full verification (default)
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --quick      # Skip build, fast tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --backend    # Backend tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --frontend   # Frontend tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --unit       # Unit tests only (fastest)
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --integration # Integration tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --lint       # Lint/architecture tests only
#   ./scripts/verify.sh --help       # Show help
#

# Get the directory where this script is located
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

# Colors
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
CYAN='\033[0;36m'
MAGENTA='\033[0;35m'
BOLD='\033[1m'
DIM='\033[2m'
NC='\033[0m'

# Default modes
RUN_BACKEND=true
RUN_FRONTEND=true
RUN_TYPES=true
RUN_BUILD=true
QUICK_MODE=false
VERBOSE=false

# Test filters
PYTEST_MARKERS="not smoke"
PYTEST_PATHS="tests/"

# ============================================================================
# Help
# ============================================================================

show_help() {
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}⬢ Synapse Verification Script${NC}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Usage:${NC}"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh [OPTIONS]"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Options:${NC}"
    echo "  --help, -h        Show this help message"
    echo "  --quick, -q       Quick mode: skip build, exclude slow tests"
    echo "  --verbose, -v     Verbose output (show all test details)"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Scope Options:${NC}"
    echo "  --backend, -b     Run only backend (Python) tests"
    echo "  --frontend, -f    Run only frontend (TypeScript) tests"
    echo "  --all, -a         Run all checks (default)"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Backend Test Filters:${NC}"
    echo "  --unit            Run only unit tests (tests/unit/)"
    echo "  --integration     Run only integration tests (tests/integration/)"
    echo "  --store           Run only store tests (tests/store/)"
    echo "  --lint            Run only lint/architecture tests (tests/lint/)"
    echo "  --smoke           Run offline smoke tests (CDN/proxy pipeline)"
    echo "  --smoke-live      Run all smoke tests including live CDN"
    echo "  --no-slow         Exclude tests marked @pytest.mark.slow"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Examples:${NC}"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh                    # Full verification"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --quick            # Fast verification"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --backend --unit   # Only Python unit tests"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh -b --no-slow       # Backend without slow tests"
    echo "  ./scripts/verify.sh --lint             # Architecture checks only"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Test Structure:${NC}"
    echo "  tests/"
    echo "  ├── unit/           # Fast, isolated tests"
    echo "  │   ├── core/       # src/core/ tests"
    echo "  │   ├── clients/    # src/clients/ tests"
    echo "  │   └── utils/      # src/utils/ tests"
    echo "  ├── store/          # Store/API tests"
    echo "  ├── integration/    # Multi-component tests"
    echo "  └── lint/           # Architecture enforcement"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BOLD}Pytest Markers:${NC}"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.slow         # Long-running tests"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.integration  # Require multiple components"
    echo "  @pytest.mark.civitai      # Civitai API related"
    echo ""
}

# ============================================================================
# Parse Arguments
# ============================================================================

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --help|-h)
            show_help
            exit 0
            ;;
        --quick|-q)
            QUICK_MODE=true
            RUN_BUILD=false
            PYTEST_MARKERS="not slow"
            shift
            ;;
        --verbose|-v)
            VERBOSE=true
            shift
            ;;
        --backend|-b)
            RUN_BACKEND=true
            RUN_FRONTEND=false
            RUN_TYPES=false
            RUN_BUILD=false
            shift
            ;;
        --frontend|-f)
            RUN_BACKEND=false
            RUN_FRONTEND=true
            RUN_TYPES=true
            RUN_BUILD=true
            shift
            ;;
        --all|-a)
            RUN_BACKEND=true
            RUN_FRONTEND=true
            RUN_TYPES=true
            RUN_BUILD=true
            shift
            ;;
        --unit)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/unit/"
            shift
            ;;
        --integration)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/integration/"
            shift
            ;;
        --store)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/store/"
            shift
            ;;
        --lint)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/lint/"
            shift
            ;;
        --smoke)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/smoke/"
            RUN_BACKEND=true
            RUN_FRONTEND=false
            RUN_TYPES=false
            RUN_BUILD=false
            if [ -z "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
                PYTEST_MARKERS="not live"
            else
                PYTEST_MARKERS="$PYTEST_MARKERS and not live"
            fi
            shift
            ;;
        --smoke-live)
            PYTEST_PATHS="tests/smoke/"
            RUN_BACKEND=true
            RUN_FRONTEND=false
            RUN_TYPES=false
            RUN_BUILD=false
            shift
            ;;
        --no-slow)
            if [ -z "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
                PYTEST_MARKERS="not slow"
            else
                PYTEST_MARKERS="$PYTEST_MARKERS and not slow"
            fi
            shift
            ;;
        *)
            echo -e "${RED}Unknown option: $1${NC}"
            echo "Use --help for usage information"
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# ============================================================================
# Header
# ============================================================================

echo -e "${MAGENTA}"
echo "╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗"
echo "║                                                                    ║"
echo "║   ⬢ Synapse - Verification Script v2.7.0                          ║"
echo "║                                                                    ║"
echo "╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝"
echo -e "${NC}"
echo -e "${CYAN}Project root: $PROJECT_ROOT${NC}"

# Show active modes
echo -e "${DIM}Modes: backend=$RUN_BACKEND frontend=$RUN_FRONTEND build=$RUN_BUILD${NC}"
if [ "$QUICK_MODE" == true ]; then
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Quick mode enabled${NC}"
fi
if [ -n "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
    echo -e "${DIM}Pytest markers: $PYTEST_MARKERS${NC}"
fi
if [ "$PYTEST_PATHS" != "tests/" ]; then
    echo -e "${DIM}Test path: $PYTEST_PATHS${NC}"
fi
echo ""

FAILED=0
WARNINGS=0
STEP=0
TOTAL_STEPS=0

# Calculate total steps
[ "$RUN_BACKEND" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 2))  # env + tests
[ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 2)) # env + tests
[ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 1))
[ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ] && TOTAL_STEPS=$((TOTAL_STEPS + 1))

# ============================================================================
# Helper Functions
# ============================================================================

check_passed() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}  ✓ $1${NC}"
}

check_failed() {
    echo -e "${RED}  ✗ $1${NC}"
    FAILED=1
}

check_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}  ! $1${NC}"
    WARNINGS=$((WARNINGS + 1))
}

check_skipped() {
    echo -e "${DIM}  ○ $1 (skipped)${NC}"
}

next_step() {
    STEP=$((STEP + 1))
    echo -e "${BOLD}[$STEP/$TOTAL_STEPS] $1${NC}"
}

# ============================================================================
# Backend Checks
# ============================================================================

if [ "$RUN_BACKEND" == true ]; then

    # 1. Python Environment
    next_step "Checking Python Environment"

    # Find Python - prefer uv, then venv, then system
    if command -v uv &> /dev/null; then
        PYTHON_CMD="uv run python"
        PYTEST_CMD="uv run pytest"
        check_passed "Using uv (recommended)"
    elif [ -f ".venv/bin/python" ]; then
        PYTHON_CMD=".venv/bin/python"
        PYTEST_CMD=".venv/bin/pytest"
        check_passed "Using virtual environment: .venv"
    elif command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
        PYTHON_CMD="python3"
        PYTEST_CMD="python3 -m pytest"
        check_warning "Using system Python (consider using uv or .venv)"
    else
        check_failed "Python not found"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check pytest is available
    if $PYTEST_CMD --version &> /dev/null; then
        check_passed "pytest available"
    else
        check_failed "pytest not installed"
    fi
    echo ""

    # 2. Backend Tests
    next_step "Running Backend Tests"

    # Build pytest command
    PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_PATHS --tb=short"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -v"
    else
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -q"
    fi

    if [ -n "$PYTEST_MARKERS" ]; then
        PYTEST_ARGS="$PYTEST_ARGS -m \"$PYTEST_MARKERS\""
    fi

    echo -e "${DIM}Running: pytest $PYTEST_ARGS${NC}"

    if eval "$PYTEST_CMD $PYTEST_ARGS"; then
        check_passed "Backend tests passed"
    else
        check_failed "Backend tests FAILED"
    fi
    echo ""
fi

# ============================================================================
# Frontend Checks
# ============================================================================

if [ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ] || [ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ] || [ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ]; then

    if [ ! -d "apps/web" ]; then
        check_failed "Frontend directory not found: apps/web"
        exit 1
    fi

    cd apps/web

    # Check package manager
    if command -v pnpm &> /dev/null; then
        PKG_MANAGER="pnpm"
    elif command -v npm &> /dev/null; then
        PKG_MANAGER="npm"
    else
        check_failed "No package manager found (pnpm or npm)"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Check node_modules
    if [ ! -d "node_modules" ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}Installing dependencies...${NC}"
        $PKG_MANAGER install --silent
    fi
fi

if [ "$RUN_FRONTEND" == true ]; then

    # 3. Frontend Environment
    next_step "Checking Frontend Environment"
    check_passed "Using $PKG_MANAGER"
    check_passed "node_modules ready"
    echo ""

    # 4. Frontend Tests
    next_step "Running Frontend Tests"

    # Run tests in CI mode (not watch mode)
    if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" == "pnpm" ]; then
        TEST_CMD="$PKG_MANAGER test --run"
    else
        TEST_CMD="$PKG_MANAGER test -- --run"
    fi

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if $TEST_CMD; then
            check_passed "Frontend tests passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend tests FAILED"
        fi
    else
        if $TEST_CMD > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            check_passed "Frontend tests passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend tests FAILED"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            $TEST_CMD
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

if [ "$RUN_TYPES" == true ]; then

    # 5. TypeScript Type Check
    next_step "TypeScript Type Check"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if npx tsc --noEmit; then
            check_passed "TypeScript types OK"
        else
            check_failed "TypeScript type errors found"
        fi
    else
        if npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 > /dev/null; then
            check_passed "TypeScript types OK"
        else
            check_failed "TypeScript type errors found"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            npx tsc --noEmit
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

if [ "$RUN_BUILD" == true ]; then

    # 6. Frontend Build
    next_step "Building Frontend"

    if [ "$VERBOSE" == true ]; then
        if $PKG_MANAGER run build; then
            check_passed "Frontend build passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend build FAILED"
        fi
    else
        if $PKG_MANAGER run build > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            check_passed "Frontend build passed"
        else
            check_failed "Frontend build FAILED"
            echo -e "${YELLOW}Running again to show errors:${NC}"
            $PKG_MANAGER run build
        fi
    fi
    echo ""
fi

cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"

# ============================================================================
# Summary
# ============================================================================

echo ""
echo -e "${MAGENTA}╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗${NC}"
if [ "$FAILED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$WARNINGS" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}║  ✓ All checks passed! Ready to commit.                             ║${NC}"
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}║  ✓ Checks passed with $WARNINGS warning(s). Review above.              ║${NC}"
    fi
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝${NC}"
    exit 0
else
    echo -e "${RED}║  ✗ Some checks FAILED. Please fix before committing.               ║${NC}"
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝${NC}"
    echo ""
    echo -e "${CYAN}Tip: Use --verbose for detailed output${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

## Výsledky smoke testů — analýza

### Co audit odhalil

`optimized=true` je stále v **3 produkčních souborech** (6 výskytů):

| Soubor | Řádky | Kontext |
|--------|-------|---------|
| `MediaPreview.tsx` | 59, 95 | `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl()` a `getCivitaiVideoUrl()` — inline helpery |
| `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` | 79, 95 | `getCivitaiVideoUrl()` a `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl()` — duplikované inline helpery |
| `media_detection.py` | 296, 329 | docstring příklad + `get_video_thumbnail_url()` |

Commit `3badab3` opravil **pouze** `civitaiTransformers.ts` (search pipeline). Ostatní soubory zůstaly nedotčené.

### Kořen problému: duplicitní URL logika

Totožná URL-building logika existuje na **4 nezávislých místech**:

1. **`civitaiTransformers.ts`** — search pipeline (tRPC/Meilisearch → browse page) — **OPRAVENO**
2. **`MediaPreview.tsx`** — inline `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl()` + `getCivitaiVideoUrl()` — **NEOPRAVENO**
3. **`FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx`** — totéž, copy-paste — **NEOPRAVENO**
4. **`media_detection.py`** — Python backend `get_video_thumbnail_url()` — **NEOPRAVENO**

Každé z těchto míst má vlastní kopii URL construction logiky. Když se opraví jedno, ostatní zůstanou rozbité. To je důvod, proč každý "fix" vytvořil nové regrese.

### Co to znamená v praxi

- **Browse page** (seznam modelů): URL jdou přes `civitaiTransformers.ts` → **funguje** (opraveno)
- **Browse page** (hover/autoplay na kartě): `MediaPreview.tsx` přepisuje URL lokálně → **rozbité** (`optimized=true` zpět)
- **Fullscreen galerie**: `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` přepisuje URL lokálně → **rozbité**
- **Pack detail** (Python-built thumbnaily): `media_detection.py` → **rozbité**

Takže uživatel vidí v browse stránce správné URL v network tabu při prvním loadu (z transformeru), ale jakmile `MediaPreview.tsx` přepíše URL pro hover/video playback, přidá `optimized=true` zpět a CDN vrátí 500.

### Co je třeba udělat

**Krok 1: Odstranit `optimized=true`** ze 3 souborů (jednoduchý fix):
- `MediaPreview.tsx` L59: `,optimized=true` → smazat
- `MediaPreview.tsx` L95: `,optimized=true` → smazat
- `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` L79: `,optimized=true` → smazat
- `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` L95: `,optimized=true` → smazat
- `media_detection.py` L329: `,optimized=true` → smazat
- `media_detection.py` L296: docstring příklad → opravit

**Krok 2: Deduplikovat URL logiku** (prevence budoucích regresí):
- `MediaPreview.tsx` a `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` mají každý vlastní `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl()`, `getCivitaiVideoUrl()`, `isCivitaiDirectUrl()`, `isLikelyVideo()` — totožný kód
- Tyto funkce by měly importovat z `civitaiTransformers.ts` (nebo nového sdíleného modulu), ne je duplikovat
- Python `media_detection.py` je separátní, ale musí být synchronizovaný

**Krok 3: Po opravě re-run smoke testů** — všech 81 testů by mělo projít zeleně (offline část), čímž se potvrdí, že fix je kompletní.

---

     8→import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react'

    25→type VideoQuality = 'sd' | 'hd' | 'fhd'
    26→type VideoFit = 'fit' | 'fill' | 'original'
    27→
    28→const QUALITY_WIDTHS: Record<VideoQuality, number> = { sd: 450, hd: 720, fhd: 1080 }
    29→const FIT_LABELS: Record<VideoFit, string> = { fit: 'FIT', fill: 'FILL', original: 'ORIG' }

    31→export const QUALITY_LABELS: Record<VideoQuality, string> = {
    32→  sd: 'SD',
    33→  hd: 'HD',
    34→  fhd: 'FHD',
    35→}
    36→
    37→export function getQualityBadge(q: VideoQuality): string | null {
    38→  if (q === 'sd') return 'viewer.qualityFast'
    39→  if (q === 'hd') return 'viewer.qualityStandard'
    40→  if (q === 'fhd') return 'viewer.qualityBest'
    41→  return null

    44→export interface MediaItem {
    45→  url: string
    46→  type?: 'image' | 'video' | 'unknown'
    47→  thumbnailUrl?: string
    48→  nsfw?: boolean
    49→  width?: number
    50→  height?: number

    55→  items: MediaItem[]

    66→/** Check if URL is a direct Civitai CDN URL (not a proxy URL). */
    67→function isCivitaiDirectUrl(url: string): boolean {
    68→  if (!url) return false
    69→  if (url.includes('/api/browse/image-proxy')) return false
    70→  return url.includes('civitai.com')
    71→}
    72→
    73→function getCivitaiVideoUrl(url: string, quality: VideoQuality = 'sd'): string {
    74→  if (!url || !isCivitaiDirectUrl(url)) return url
    75→  try {
    76→    const urlObj = new URL(url)
    77→    const parts = urlObj.pathname.split('/')
    78→    const idx = parts.findIndex(p => p.includes('=') || p.startsWith('width'))
    79→    const params = `transcode=true,width=${QUALITY_WIDTHS[quality]},optimized=true`
    80→    if (idx >= 0) parts[idx] = params
    81→    else if (parts.length >= 3) parts.splice(-1, 0, params)
    82→    const lastIdx = parts.length - 1
    83→    if (lastIdx >= 0) parts.splice(lastIdx, 1, parts[lastIdx].replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') + '.mp4')

    85→    return urlObj.toString()
    86→  } catch { return url }
    87→}

    96→    if (idx >= 0) parts[idx] = params
    97→    else if (parts.length >= 3) parts.splice(-1, 0, params)
    98→    urlObj.pathname = parts.join('/')
    99→    return urlObj.toString()

<result>Výstup je poměrně obsáhlý (a byl oříznutý binárními daty z posledního testu). Shrnu klíčové výsledky:

## Souhrn CDN Smoke testů

### Image Fetch (2/2 PASSED)
- **test_image_returns_200_or_redirect** -- URL `image.civitai.com` vrací rovnou **200** bez redirectu, `image/jpeg`, 18 KB, ~216ms
- **test_image_content_is_valid** -- Obsah je platný JPEG, ~275ms

### Video Fetch (4/4 PASSED)
- **test_video_without_anim_false_redirects** -- Video URL dostane **301 redirect** na `image-b2.civitai.com` (B2 storage), ale druhý hop vrací **401** (Authorization token v URL expiroval/nebyl přijat)
- **test_b2_redirect_empty_headers_200** -- Stejné chování: 301 -> B2 -> **401** (260ms)
- **test_b2_redirect_custom_headers_401** -- B2 s custom hlavičkami: stále **401**
- **test_video_with_anim_false_returns_image** -- S `anim=false` parametrem CDN vrátí statický thumbnail (image) namísto videa

### Klíčová zjištění o chování CDN

1. **Obrázky** fungují přímo -- `image.civitai.com` vrací 200 bez redirectu.

Všech 24 testů prošlo. Teď mám kompletní data. Pojďme to celé zanalyzovat.

---

## Kompletní analýza CDN/Proxy/Search pipeline

### Co jsem zjistil z live testů

#### 1. `optimized=true` už NEZPŮSOBUJE 500 na CDN

Tohle je kritický objev. Test `test_optimized_true_causes_error` **SELHAL** — protože Civitai CDN teď `optimized=true` přijímá s 200:

```
optimized=true  → 200, image/webp, 9 250 B  (217ms)
bez optimized   → 200, image/jpeg, 18 706 B  (234ms)
```

**Rozdíl:** `optimized=true` vrací WebP (9 KB) místo JPEG (19 KB). CDN to zpracovává jako konverzní hint. Takže `optimized=true` **není root cause** současných problémů — Civitai to mezitím opravili (nebo to nikdy nebylo tím).

#### 2. Video playback je principiálně nemožný přes proxy

Redirect chain pro video:
```
image.civitai.com (301, 45ms) → image-b2.civitai.com/...?Authorization=... (401, 242ms)
```

B2 storage vydává **krátkodobý autorizační token** v redirect URL. Tento token:
- Je vázán na session/IP/čas
- Expiruje rychle
- Proxy ho nemůže předat browseru (CORS)

**Důsledek:** Video playback přes náš proxy **nikdy nemůže fungovat** pro Civitai videa. Proxy správně fast-failuje za 0.3s s 502. To je **správné chování**.

#### 3. Thumbnaily (anim=false) fungují perfektně

```
anim=false,transcode=true,width=450 → 200, image/webp, 13 734 B (40ms)
```

Žádný redirect, přímá odpověď, 40ms. Toto je **spolehlivá cesta** pro video preview.

#### 4. Obrázky fungují perfektně přes proxy

```
Proxy image   → 200, 18 706 B
10 paralelních → 10/10 success, 0.6s
Mixed (video+image) → [200, 502, 200, 200], 0.8s
```

Proxy zvládá concurrency, video neblokuje obrázky.

### Root causes problémů v aplikaci

Na základě těchto zjištění, zde jsou skutečné příčiny problémů:

#### Problém 1: "Videa nejdou"

**Příčina:** Video `.mp4` soubory se na Civitai CDN redirectují na B2 storage s autorizačním tokenem. Token je IP/session-bound → proxy ho nemůže forwardovat. Video **nemůže** hrát přes proxy.

**Řešení:** Aplikace to správně handluje — `MediaPreview.tsx` zobrazí statický thumbnail (anim=false) a při hoveru se pokusí o video, které selže → fallback na thumbnail. Ale `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` se pokouší přehrát video přímo → čeká, bufferuje, selhává.

**Správný přístup:**
- Video preview v kartách: thumbnail (anim=false) — funguje
- Fullscreen: zobrazit thumbnail + informaci "Video playback unavailable via proxy"
- NEBO: frontend fetchne video přímo z `image.civitai.com` (ne přes proxy) — ale CORS to blokuje

#### Problém 2: "Zasekávání přechodů mezi previews a search"

**Příčina:** `MediaPreview.tsx` a `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` mají inline `isCivitaiDirectUrl()` check, který vrací `false` pro proxy URLs (`/api/browse/image-proxy?url=...`). Když search pipeline vrátí proxy-wrapped URL, tyto komponenty ho **nepřepisují** (protože to není "direct URL"). Ale pokud jiná cesta předá raw CDN URL, přepíší ho a přidají `optimized=true`.

Dva paralelní kódové cesty:
1. **Search → civitaiTransformers.ts → proxy URL** → MediaPreview dostane `/api/browse/image-proxy?url=...` → `isCivitaiDirectUrl()` = false → použije URL as-is → **funguje**
2. **Pack detail / direct link** → raw CDN URL → `isCivitaiDirectUrl()` = true → přepíše s `optimized=true` → **dřív padalo, teď vrací menší WebP**

#### Problém 3: "Failed loads hlášky"

**Příčina:** Kombinace:
1. Video src se nastaví na proxy URL s `.mp4` → proxy vrátí 502 (fast-fail) → `onError` → "Failed to load"
2. Thumbnail src selhání → `handleImageError` → `forceVideoDisplay(true)` → zkusí video → video 502 → obojí selhalo → "Load failed"
3. Při hover: `showVideo = true` → nastaví `src={videoUrl}` → 502 → error state

#### Problém 4: "24 concurrent video autoPlay freeze"

**Příčina:** Browse page má 24 karet s `autoPlay={true}`. Každá karta:
1. Loadne thumbnail (OK, 40ms)
2. Okamžitě zkusí video (autoPlay) → 24× proxy request na `.mp4` → 24× B2 redirect → 24× 401 → 24× proxy 502
3. Prohlížeč má limit 6 paralelních connections na doménu → queue se hromadí
4. Video error → fallback → re-render → nový request cycle

### Plán opravy

Na základě zjištění navrhuji tento plán:

**Fáze 1: Okamžité opravy (MediaPreview + FullscreenMediaViewer)**

1. **Nikdy se nepokoušet o video playback přes proxy** — pokud URL je proxy URL (`/api/browse/image-proxy`), video element nezobrazovat vůbec. Proxy nemůže streamovat video.

2. **Odstranit duplikovanou URL logiku** z `MediaPreview.tsx` a `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` — importovat z `civitaiTransformers.ts`.

3. **autoPlay=true nesmí spouštět video fetch** — autoPlay má pouze přehrávat, pokud video URL je dostupné (např. lokální soubor). Pro proxy URLs pouze zobrazit thumbnail.

**Fáze 2: Backend opravy**

4. **Odstranit `optimized=true`** z `media_detection.py` — sice teď nerozbíjí CDN, ale je to zbytečný parametr a matoucí.

**Fáze 3: Architektonické vylepšení**

5. **Single source of truth pro URL transformaci** — `civitaiTransformers.ts` je autoritativní. Ostatní soubory importují z něj.

6. **Video playback strategie:** Pro Civitai videa definovat jasně:
   - V kartách: vždy thumbnail (anim=false), žádný video attempt
   - Ve fullscreenu: thumbnail + "přehrát na Civitai" odkaz
   - Pro lokální/pack videa: normální video playback

)

class TestCdnImageFetch:

    async def test_image_returns_200_or_redirect(self, async_client, network_available):
        skip_if_offline(network_available)
        result = await fetch_with_trace(async_client, KNOWN_IMAGE_URL)
        print_trace(result, "image_fetch")
        assert result.final_status in (200, 301, 302), (
            f"Expected 200 or redirect, got {result.final_status}"
        )

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_image_content_is_valid(self, async_client, network_available):
        skip_if_offline(network_available)
        result = await fetch_with_trace(async_client, KNOWN_IMAGE_URL)
        print_trace(result, "image_content")
        if result.final_status == 200 and result.content:
            # Check magic bytes for JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF
            first_bytes = result.content[:4]
            is_valid = any(
                first_bytes.startswith(magic)
                for magic in MAGIC_BYTES.values()
            )
            assert is_valid, (
                f"Content doesn't match any known image format. "
                f"First 8 bytes: {result.content[:8].hex()}"
            )

class TestCdnVideoFetch:
    """Verify video URL behavior — B2 redirects, anim=false thumbnails."""

    async def test_video_without_anim_false_redirects(self, async_client, network_available):

        result = await fetch_with_trace(async_client, KNOWN_VIDEO_URL, timeout=10.0)
        print_trace(result, "video_redirect")

            f"Expected redirect or auth failure, got {result.final_status}"
        )

            async_client, KNOWN_VIDEO_URL, timeout=15.0

        print_trace(result, "b2_empty_headers")

        skip_if_offline(network_available)
        import httpx

        # First, get the redirect URL
        resp = await async_client.get(

        )

        # B2 rejects custom headers (or at least Authorization-like headers)
        # Accept either 401 or 403 as "auth rejected"
        assert resp2.status_code in (400, 401, 403), (
            f"Expected B2 auth rejection, got {resp2.status_code}"
        )

1→/**
     2→ * Search Adapters Registry
     3→ *
     4→ * Central registry for all search adapters.
     5→ * Provides helper functions for adapter selection and availability checking.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import type { SearchAdapter, SearchProvider } from './searchTypes'
     9→import { RestSearchAdapter } from './adapters/restAdapter'
    10→import { ArchiveSearchAdapter } from './adapters/archiveAdapter'
    11→import { TrpcBridgeAdapter } from './adapters/trpcBridgeAdapter'
    12→
    13→// =============================================================================
    14→// Singleton Adapter Instances
    15→// =============================================================================
    16→
    17→const adapters: Record<SearchProvider, SearchAdapter> = {
    18→  rest: new RestSearchAdapter(),
    19→  archive: new ArchiveSearchAdapter(),
    20→  trpc: new TrpcBridgeAdapter(),
    21→}
    22→
    23→// =============================================================================
    24→// Public API
    25→// =============================================================================
    26→
    27→/**
    28→ * Get adapter by provider name.
    29→ */
    30→export function getAdapter(provider: SearchProvider): SearchAdapter {
    31→  return adapters[provider]
    32→}
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Get all adapters (for testing/debugging).
    36→ */
    37→export function getAllAdapters(): SearchAdapter[] {
    38→  return Object.values(adapters)
    39→}
    40→
    41→/**
    42→ * Get all available adapters (for UI dropdown).
    43→ * Only returns adapters that are currently available.
    44→ */
    45→export function getAvailableAdapters(): SearchAdapter[] {
    46→  return Object.values(adapters).filter((a) => a.isAvailable())
    47→}
    48→
    49→/**
    50→ * Check if a specific provider is available.
    51→ */
    52→export function isProviderAvailable(provider: SearchProvider): boolean {
    53→  return adapters[provider]?.isAvailable() ?? false
    54→}
    55→
    56→/**
    57→ * Get default provider.
    58→ * Prefers tRPC if available (fastest), otherwise REST.
    59→ */
    60→export function getDefaultProvider(): SearchProvider {
    61→  if (adapters.trpc.isAvailable()) return 'trpc'
    62→  return 'rest'
    63→}
    64→
    65→/**
    66→ * Get provider with fallback.
    67→ * If requested provider is unavailable, returns a fallback.
    68→ */
    69→export function getProviderWithFallback(
    70→  preferred: SearchProvider
    71→): SearchProvider {
    72→  if (adapters[preferred]?.isAvailable()) {

    74→  }
    75→
    76→  // Fallback chain: trpc → rest
    77→  if (preferred === 'trpc' && adapters.rest.isAvailable()) {

    79→    return 'rest'
    80→  }

    82→  // Archive only for search, not general fallback
    83→  return 'rest'
    84→}

    91→export { ArchiveSearchAdapter } from './adapters/archiveAdapter'

1→/**
     2→ * REST API Search Adapter
     3→ *
     4→ * Uses the existing backend /api/browse endpoints.
     5→ * Always available, stable and reliable.
     6→ *
     7→ * REST backend returns raw Civitai CDN URLs which need proxying
     8→ * (Civitai CDN blocks direct browser requests without proper Referer).
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import type {
    12→  SearchAdapter,
    13→  SearchParams,
    14→  SearchResult,
    15→  ModelDetail,
    16→  CivitaiModel,
    17→} from '../searchTypes'
    18→import { toProxyUrl } from '@/lib/utils/civitaiTransformers'
    19→
    20→export class RestSearchAdapter implements SearchAdapter {
    21→  readonly provider = 'rest' as const
    22→  readonly displayName = 'REST API'
    23→  readonly description = 'Standard API, stable and reliable'
    24→  readonly icon = 'Globe'
    25→
    26→  isAvailable(): boolean {
    27→    return true // Always available
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  async search(params: SearchParams, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SearchResult> {
    31→    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams()
    32→
    33→    if (params.query) urlParams.append('query', params.query)
    34→    if (params.types?.length) urlParams.append('types', params.types.join(','))
    35→    if (params.sort) urlParams.append('sort', params.sort)
    36→    if (params.nsfw !== undefined) urlParams.append('nsfw', String(params.nsfw))
    37→    if (params.cursor) urlParams.append('cursor', params.cursor)
    38→    urlParams.append('limit', String(params.limit || 20))
    39→
    40→    const startTime = Date.now()
    41→
    42→    const res = await fetch(`/api/browse/search?${urlParams}`, { signal })
    43→
    44→    if (!res.ok) {
    45→      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
    46→      throw new Error(err.detail || 'Search failed')
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    const data = await res.json()
    50→    const items = (data.items || []).map(proxyModelUrls)
    51→
    52→    return {
    53→      items,
    54→      nextCursor: data.next_cursor,
    55→      hasMore: !!data.next_cursor,
    56→      metadata: {
    57→        source: 'rest',
    58→        totalItems: data.total,
    59→        responseTime: Date.now() - startTime,
    60→      },
    61→    }
    62→  }
    63→
    64→  async getModelDetail(modelId: number): Promise<ModelDetail> {
    65→    const res = await fetch(`/api/browse/model/${modelId}`)
    66→
    67→    if (!res.ok) {
    68→      throw new Error('Failed to fetch model')
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    const data: ModelDetail = await res.json()
    72→    return proxyModelUrls(data)
    73→  }
    74→}
    75→
    76→/**
    77→ * Proxy all Civitai CDN URLs in a model's previews.
    78→ * REST backend returns raw CDN URLs which browsers can't load
    79→ * (Civitai CDN requires proper Referer header).
    80→ */
    81→function proxyModelUrls<T extends CivitaiModel>(model: T): T {
    82→  if (!model.previews?.length) return model
    83→  return {
    84→    ...model,
    85→    previews: model.previews.map((p) => ({
    86→      ...p,
    87→      url: toProxyUrl(p.url),
    88→      thumbnail_url: p.thumbnail_url ? toProxyUrl(p.thumbnail_url) : p.thumbnail_url,
    89→    })),
    90→  }
    91→}
    92→

1→/**
     2→ * tRPC Bridge Search Adapter
     3→ *
     4→ * Uses Tampermonkey bridge with HYBRID search strategy:
     5→ * - Meilisearch for full-text search (fast, when query provided)
     6→ * - tRPC model.getAll for browse without query (better sorting)
     7→ *
     8→ * Bypasses CORS via GM_xmlhttpRequest.
     9→ *
    10→ * Requires: Synapse Civitai Bridge v10+ userscript installed in Tampermonkey.
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import type {
    14→  SearchAdapter,
    15→  SearchParams,
    16→  SearchResult,
    17→  ModelDetail,
    18→  ModelPreview,
    19→} from '../searchTypes'
    20→import { transformTrpcModel, transformMeilisearchModel, transformTrpcModelDetail, transformPreview } from '@/lib/utils/civitaiTransformers'
    21→
    22→// Timeout for image.getInfinite which is inherently slow
    23→const IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT = 60000
    24→
    25→// =============================================================================
    26→// Bridge Type Declaration
    27→// =============================================================================
    28→
    29→interface BridgeSearchResult {
    30→  ok: boolean
    31→  data?: {
    32→    items?: Record<string, unknown>[]
    33→    nextCursor?: string
    34→    hasMore?: boolean
    35→    totalHits?: number
    36→  }
    37→  error?: {
    38→    code: string
    39→    message: string
    40→  }
    41→  meta?: {
    42→    durationMs: number
    43→    cached: boolean
    44→    source: 'meilisearch' | 'trpc'
    45→    query?: string
    46→  }
    47→}
    48→
    49→interface SynapseSearchBridge {
    50→  version: string
    51→  isEnabled(): boolean
    52→  getStatus(): {
    53→    enabled: boolean
    54→    nsfw: boolean
    55→    version: string
    56→    cacheSize: number
    57→    features?: string[]
    58→  }
    59→  configure?(updates: { enabled?: boolean; nsfw?: boolean }): void
    60→  // Hybrid search (auto-selects Meilisearch or tRPC)
    61→  search(
    62→    request: {
    63→      q?: string
    64→      limit?: number
    65→      sort?: string
    66→      period?: string
    67→      cursor?: string
    68→      offset?: number
    69→      filters?: {
    70→        types?: string | string[]
    71→        baseModel?: string | string[]
    72→      }
    73→    },
    74→    opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal; noCache?: boolean; forceTrpc?: boolean }
    75→  ): Promise<BridgeSearchResult>
    76→  // Direct Meilisearch search
    77→  searchMeilisearch?(
    78→    request: {
    79→      q?: string
    80→      limit?: number
    81→      offset?: number
    82→      filters?: {
    83→        types?: string | string[]
    84→        baseModel?: string | string[]
    85→      }
    86→    },
    87→    opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal; noCache?: boolean }
    88→  ): Promise<BridgeSearchResult>
    89→  // Direct tRPC search
    90→  searchTrpc?(
    91→    request: {
    92→      q?: string
    93→      limit?: number
    94→      sort?: string
    95→      period?: string
    96→      cursor?: string
    97→      filters?: {
    98→        types?: string
    99→        baseModel?: string
   100→      }
   101→    },
   102→    opts?: { signal?: AbortSignal; noCache?: boolean }
   103→  ): Promise<BridgeSearchResult>
   104→  getModel?(modelId: number, opts?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<BridgeSearchResult>
   105→  getModelImages?(modelId: number, opts?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<BridgeSearchResult>
   106→  test?(): Promise<{ ok: boolean; results: { meilisearch: unknown; trpc: unknown } }>
   107→}
   108→
   109→declare global {
   110→  interface Window {
   111→    SynapseSearchBridge?: SynapseSearchBridge
   112→  }
   113→}
   114→
   115→// =============================================================================
   116→// tRPC Bridge Adapter (Hybrid: Meilisearch + tRPC)
   117→// =============================================================================
   118→
   119→export class TrpcBridgeAdapter implements SearchAdapter {
   120→  readonly provider = 'trpc' as const
   121→  readonly displayName = 'Internal tRPC'
   122→  readonly description = 'Fast, direct API via browser extension'
   123→  readonly icon = 'Zap'
   124→
   125→  // Track current offset for Meilisearch pagination
   126→  private meilisearchOffset = 0
   127→
   128→  isAvailable(): boolean {
   129→    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false
   130→    return !!window.SynapseSearchBridge?.isEnabled?.()
   131→  }
   132→
   133→  /**
   134→   * Get bridge version info
   135→   */
   136→  getVersion(): string {
   137→    return window.SynapseSearchBridge?.version || 'unknown'
   138→  }
   139→
   140→  /**
   141→   * Check if bridge supports Meilisearch (v10+)
   142→   */
   143→  supportsMeilisearch(): boolean {
   144→    const status = window.SynapseSearchBridge?.getStatus?.()
   145→    return status?.features?.includes('meilisearch') ?? false
   146→  }
   147→
   148→  async search(
   149→    params: SearchParams,
   150→    signal?: AbortSignal
   151→  ): Promise<SearchResult> {
   152→    const bridge = window.SynapseSearchBridge
   153→
   154→    if (!bridge) {
   155→      throw new Error('Bridge not available. Install Tampermonkey extension.')
   156→    }
   157→
   158→    const startTime = Date.now()
   159→
   160→    // Reset offset on new search (no cursor = new search)
   161→    if (!params.cursor) {
   162→      this.meilisearchOffset = 0
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const result = await bridge.search(
   166→      {
   167→        q: params.query || '',
   168→        limit: params.limit || 20,
   169→        sort: params.sort || 'Most Downloaded',
   170→        period: params.period || 'AllTime',
   171→        cursor: params.cursor,
   172→        offset: this.meilisearchOffset,
   173→        filters: {
   174→          // Support multiple types
   175→          types: params.types?.length ? params.types : undefined,
   176→          baseModel: params.baseModels?.length ? params.baseModels[0] : undefined,
   177→        },
   178→      },
   179→      { signal }
   180→    )
   181→
   182→    if (!result.ok) {
   183→      throw new Error(result.error?.message || 'Search failed')
   184→    }
   185→
   186→    // Determine which transformer to use based on source
   187→    const isMeilisearch = result.meta?.source === 'meilisearch'
   188→    const rawItems = result.data?.items || []
   189→
   190→    // Transform items based on source
   191→    const items = rawItems.map((item) =>
   192→      isMeilisearch ? transformMeilisearchModel(item) : transformTrpcModel(item)
   193→    )
   194→
   195→    // Update offset for next Meilisearch request
   196→    if (isMeilisearch && result.data?.hasMore) {
   197→      this.meilisearchOffset += items.length
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    // For Meilisearch, we use offset-based pagination
   201→    // For tRPC, we use cursor-based pagination
   202→    const nextCursor = isMeilisearch
   203→      ? result.data?.hasMore
   204→        ? String(this.meilisearchOffset)
   205→        : undefined
   206→      : result.data?.nextCursor
   207→
   208→    return {
   209→      items,
   210→      nextCursor,
   211→      hasMore: result.data?.hasMore ?? !!nextCursor,
   212→      metadata: {
   213→        source: 'trpc',
   214→        cached: result.meta?.cached || false,
   215→        responseTime: result.meta?.durationMs || Date.now() - startTime,
   216→        totalItems: result.data?.totalHits,
   217→      },
   218→    }
   219→  }
   220→
   221→  /**
   222→   * Get model info FAST (no image fetching).
   223→   *
   224→   * For tRPC: calls bridge.getModel() which returns in ~1s (model data only, images empty).
   225→   * For REST fallback: calls /api/browse/model/{id} which includes images.
   226→   *
   227→   * Images are loaded separately via getModelPreviews() for progressive loading.
   228→   */
   229→  async getModelDetail(modelId: number): Promise<ModelDetail> {
   230→    const bridge = window.SynapseSearchBridge
   231→
   232→    // Use bridge's direct tRPC call if available (fast — model data only, no images)
   233→    if (bridge?.getModel) {
   234→      try {
   235→        const modelResult = await bridge.getModel(modelId)
   236→        if (modelResult.ok) {
   237→          return transformTrpcModelDetail(modelResult.data as Record<string, unknown>)
   238→        }
   239→        throw new Error(modelResult.error?.message || 'Model fetch failed')
   240→      } catch (err) {
   241→        console.warn('[Synapse] Bridge model fetch failed, using REST fallback:', err)
   242→      }
   243→    }
   244→
   245→    // Fallback to REST (includes images — no need for separate getModelPreviews)
   246→    const res = await fetch(`/api/browse/model/${modelId}`)
   247→    if (!res.ok) {
   248→      throw new Error('Failed to fetch model')
   249→    }
   250→    return res.json()
   251→  }
   252→
   253→  /**
   254→   * Fetch preview images separately via bridge (progressive loading).
   255→   *
   256→   * Called by BrowsePage as Query 2, only when getModelDetail returned 0 previews.
   257→   * Uses image.getInfinite which requires modelVersionId (NOT modelId!).
   258→   * 15s timeout protects against Civitai hangs.
   259→   */
   260→  async getModelPreviews(modelId: number, versionId: number): Promise<ModelPreview[]> {
   261→    const bridge = window.SynapseSearchBridge
   262→    if (!bridge?.getModelImages) {
   263→      throw new Error('Bridge getModelImages not available')
   264→    }
   265→
   266→    const result = await Promise.race([
   267→      bridge.getModelImages(versionId, { limit: 50, timeout: IMAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT }),
   268→      new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
   269→        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('getModelImages timeout')), 15_000)
   270→      ),
   271→    ])
   272→
   273→    if (!result.ok) {
   274→      throw new Error(result.error?.message || 'Image fetch failed')
   275→    }
   276→
   277→    return (result.data?.items || []).map((item) =>
   278→      transformPreview(item as Record<string, unknown>)
   279→    )
   280→  }
   281→}
   282→

    29→  async search(params: SearchParams, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SearchResult> {
    30→    if (!params.query) {
    31→      return {
    32→        items: [],
    33→        hasMore: false,
    34→        metadata: { source: 'archive' },
    35→      }
    36→    }
    37→
    38→    // Reset page on new search (no cursor = new search)
    39→    if (!params.cursor) {
    40→      this.currentPage = 1
    41→    }
    42→
    43→    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams()
    44→    urlParams.append('query', params.query)
    45→    urlParams.append('limit', String(params.limit || 20))
    46→    // One page per request - user clicks "Load More" for next page
    47→    urlParams.append('page', String(this.currentPage))
    48→
    49→    const startTime = Date.now()
    50→
    51→    const res = await fetch(`/api/browse/search-civarchive?${urlParams}`, {
    52→      signal,
    53→    })
    54→
    55→    if (!res.ok) {
    56→      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
    57→      throw new Error(err.detail || 'CivArchive search failed')
    58→    }
    59→
    60→    const data = await res.json()
    61→
    62→    // Transform CivArchiveResult → CivitaiModel
    63→    const items: CivitaiModel[] = (data.results || []).map(
    64→      (r: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
    65→        id: r.model_id as number,
    66→        name: (r.model_name as string) || '',
    67→        type: (r.model_type as string) || 'Unknown',
    68→        nsfw: (r.nsfw as boolean) || false,
    69→        tags: [],
    70→        creator: r.creator as string | undefined,
    71→        stats: {
    72→          downloadCount: r.download_count as number | undefined,
    73→          rating: r.rating as number | undefined,
    74→        },
    75→        versions: [
    76→          {
    77→            id: r.version_id as number,
    78→            name: (r.version_name as string) || 'Default',
    79→            base_model: r.base_model as string | undefined,
    80→            download_url: r.download_url as string | undefined,
    81→            file_size: r.file_size as number | undefined,
    82→            trained_words: [],
    83→            files: r.file_name
    84→              ? [
    85→                  {
    86→                    id: 0,
    87→                    name: r.file_name as string,
    88→                    size_kb: r.file_size
    89→                      ? (r.file_size as number) / 1024
    90→                      : undefined,
    91→                    download_url: r.download_url as string | undefined,
    92→                  },
    93→                ]
    94→              : [],
    95→          },
    96→        ],
    97→        // Backend already transforms previews with video detection
    98→        previews: (r.previews as CivitaiModel['previews']) || [],
    99→      })
   100→    )
   101→
   102→    // Phase 5: Increment page for next Load More
   103→    if (data.has_more) {
   104→      this.currentPage++
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    return {
   108→      items,
   109→      hasMore: data.has_more || false,
   110→      nextCursor: data.has_more ? String(this.currentPage) : undefined,
   111→      metadata: {
   112→        source: 'archive',
   113→        totalItems: data.total_found as number,
   114→        responseTime: Date.now() - startTime,
   115→      },
   116→    }
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  // CivArchive doesn't support direct model fetch - would need to go through REST
   120→}
