1→/**
     2→ * Civitai Data Transformers for Phase 5
     3→ *
     4→ * These transformers convert tRPC API responses to the unified CivitaiModel format.
     5→ * CRITICAL: Video detection must match backend logic in src/utils/media_detection.py!
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import type {
     9→  CivitaiModel,
    10→  ModelPreview,
    11→  ModelVersion,
    12→  ModelDetail,
    13→  ModelFile,
    14→} from '@/lib/api/searchTypes'
    15→import type { MediaType } from '@/lib/media'
    16→
    17→// =============================================================================
    18→// Image Proxy (for Civitai CDN URLs)
    19→// =============================================================================
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Convert a Civitai CDN URL to use our image proxy.
    23→ * This avoids CORS issues and potential blocking.
    24→ */
    25→export function toProxyUrl(url: string): string {
    26→  if (!url) return url
    27→
    28→  // Already proxied — don't double-wrap
    29→  if (url.includes('/api/browse/image-proxy')) {
    30→    return url
    31→  }
    32→
    33→  // Only proxy Civitai CDN URLs
    34→  if (
    35→    !url.includes('image.civitai.com') &&
    36→    !url.includes('images.civitai.com') &&
    37→    !url.includes('cdn.civitai.com')
    38→  ) {
    39→    return url
    40→  }
    41→
    42→  return `/api/browse/image-proxy?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`
    43→}
    44→
    45→// =============================================================================
    46→// Media Detection (MUST match backend!)
    47→// =============================================================================
    48→
    49→/**
    50→ * Check if filename indicates a video file.
    51→ * tRPC API returns filename in the `name` field (e.g., "video.mp4", "image.jpeg")
    52→ */
    53→function isVideoFilename(filename: string | null): boolean {
    54→  if (!filename) return false
    55→  return /\.(mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv)$/i.test(filename)
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Detect media type from URL.
    60→ * CRITICAL: This MUST match backend logic in src/utils/media_detection.py!
    61→ */
    62→export function detectMediaType(url: string): MediaType {
    63→  if (!url) return 'unknown'
    64→
    65→  const lowerUrl = url.toLowerCase()
    66→
    67→  // Extension check - video extensions
    68→  if (lowerUrl.match(/\.(mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv)(\?|$)/)) {
    69→    return 'video'
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  // Civitai transcode=true pattern indicates video
    73→  // BUT anim=false means it's a static thumbnail
    74→  if (lowerUrl.includes('transcode=true') && !lowerUrl.includes('anim=false')) {
    75→    return 'video'
    76→  }
    77→
    78→  // Path pattern - /videos/ in URL
    79→  if (lowerUrl.includes('/videos/')) {
    80→    return 'video'
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // type=video query param
    84→  if (lowerUrl.includes('type=video')) {
    85→    return 'video'
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  // Default to image (same as backend)
    89→  return 'image'
    90→}
    91→
    92→/**
    93→ * Get video thumbnail URL (static frame).
    94→ * CRITICAL: This MUST match backend logic in src/utils/media_detection.py!
    95→ */
    96→export function getVideoThumbnailUrl(url: string, width = 450): string {
    97→  if (!url) return url
    98→
    99→  // Non-Civitai: simple extension replacement
   100→  if (!url.includes('civitai.com')) {
   101→    return url.replace(/\.(mp4|webm|mov)$/i, '.jpg')
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  // Civitai uses path-based params like /anim=false,width=450/
   105→  // Find the params segment or create one
   106→  const parts = url.split('/')
   107→  const filename = parts.pop() || ''
   108→
   109→  // Look for existing params segment (contains '=' but not '://')
   110→  let paramsIdx = parts.findIndex((p) => p.includes('=') && !p.includes('://'))
   111→
   112→  if (paramsIdx === -1) {
   113→    // No params yet, add before filename
   114→    parts.push(`anim=false,transcode=true,width=${width}`)
   115→  } else {
   116→    // Modify existing params
   117→    let params = parts[paramsIdx]
   118→
   119→    // Ensure anim=false (for static thumbnail)
   120→    if (params.includes('anim=true')) {
   121→      params = params.replace('anim=true', 'anim=false')
   122→    } else if (!params.includes('anim=')) {
   123→      params = `anim=false,${params}`
   124→    }
   125→
   126→    // Update width
   127→    params = params.replace(/width=\d+/, `width=${width}`)
   128→    if (!params.includes('width=')) {
   129→      params += `,width=${width}`
   130→    }
   131→
   132→    parts[paramsIdx] = params
   133→  }
   134→
   135→  parts.push(filename)
   136→  return parts.join('/')
   137→}
   138→
   139→// =============================================================================
   140→// tRPC Model Transformer
   141→// =============================================================================
   142→
   143→/**
   144→ * Transform tRPC model item to CivitaiModel.
   145→ * Handles video detection for previews - CRITICAL!
   146→ */
   147→export function transformTrpcModel(item: Record<string, unknown>): CivitaiModel {
   148→  const versions = transformVersions(item.modelVersions as Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined)
   149→
   150→  // tRPC model.getAll returns images at TOP LEVEL, not in modelVersions!
   151→  // Try multiple locations for images:
   152→  // 1. item.images (tRPC list response)
   153→  // 2. item.modelVersions[].images (full model response - ALL versions!)
   154→  let images: Record<string, unknown>[] = []
   155→
   156→  // Check top-level images first (tRPC list format)
   157→  if (Array.isArray(item.images) && item.images.length > 0) {
   158→    images = item.images as Record<string, unknown>[]
   159→  }
   160→  // Fallback to modelVersions (full model format) - collect from ALL versions
   161→  else if (item.modelVersions) {
   162→    const allVersions = item.modelVersions as Record<string, unknown>[]
   163→    for (const version of allVersions) {
   164→      if (version?.images && Array.isArray(version.images)) {
   165→        images.push(...(version.images as Record<string, unknown>[]))
   166→      }
   167→    }
   168→  }
   169→
   170→  const previews: ModelPreview[] = images.slice(0, 8).map(transformPreview)
   171→
   172→  // Get creator name
   173→  const user = item.user as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
   174→  const creator = item.creator as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
   175→  const creatorName = (user?.username || creator?.username || '') as string
   176→
   177→  // Get stats
   178→  const stats = item.stats as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
   179→
   180→  return {
   181→    id: item.id as number,
   182→    name: (item.name as string) || '',
   183→    description: item.description as string | undefined,
   184→    type: (item.type as string) || '',
   185→    // CRITICAL: Model-level NSFW
   186→    nsfw: (item.nsfw as boolean) || false,
   187→    tags: (item.tags as string[]) || [],
   188→    creator: creatorName,
   189→    stats: {
   190→      downloadCount: stats?.downloadCount as number | undefined,
   191→      favoriteCount: stats?.favoriteCount as number | undefined,
   192→      commentCount: stats?.commentCount as number | undefined,
   193→      ratingCount: stats?.ratingCount as number | undefined,
   194→      rating: stats?.rating as number | undefined,
   195→      thumbsUpCount: stats?.thumbsUpCount as number | undefined,
   196→    },
   197→    versions,
   198→    previews,
   199→  }
   200→}
   201→
   202→/**
   203→ * Build full Civitai image URL from UUID.
   204→ * tRPC returns only UUID, we need to construct full URL.
   205→ */
   206→function buildCivitaiImageUrl(
   207→  uuid: string,
   208→  filename: string | null,
   209→  isVideo = false,
   210→  width = 450
   211→): string {
   212→  if (!uuid) return ''
   213→
   214→  // If it's already a full URL, return as-is
   215→  if (uuid.startsWith('http')) return uuid
   216→
   217→  // Civitai CDN base
   218→  const cdnBase = 'https://image.civitai.com/xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA'
   219→
   220→  // Use filename or default
   221→  let name = filename || (isVideo ? 'video.mp4' : 'image.jpeg')
   222→
   223→  // For videos, ensure .mp4 extension
   224→  if (isVideo && !name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.mp4')) {
   225→    name = name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '.mp4')
   226→  }
   227→
   228→  // Build params based on type
   229→  const params = isVideo
   230→    ? `transcode=true,width=${width}`
   231→    : `width=${width}`
   232→
   233→  return `${cdnBase}/${uuid}/${params}/${name}`
   234→}
   235→
   236→/**
   237→ * Transform a single preview/image.
   238→ */
   239→export function transformPreview(img: Record<string, unknown>): ModelPreview {
   240→  const rawUrl = (img.url as string) || ''
   241→  const filename = img.name as string | null
   242→  const imgType = img.type as string | undefined
   243→
   244→  // Determine if video:
   245→  // 1. tRPC provides explicit type field
   246→  // 2. Filename extension (e.g., "video.mp4") - critical for tRPC UUID responses!
   247→  // 3. Fallback to URL-based detection (for REST/other formats)
   248→  const isVideoByType = imgType === 'video'
   249→  const isVideoByFilename = isVideoFilename(filename)
   250→  const isVideoByUrl = rawUrl.startsWith('http') && detectMediaType(rawUrl) === 'video'
   251→  const isVideo = isVideoByType || isVideoByFilename || isVideoByUrl
   252→
   253→  // Build full URL from UUID if needed
   254→  const originalUrl = buildCivitaiImageUrl(rawUrl, filename, isVideo)
   255→
   256→  // CRITICAL: Proxy Civitai URLs to avoid CORS/blocking
   257→  const url = toProxyUrl(originalUrl)
   258→
   259→  // Determine media type
   260→  const mediaType: MediaType = isVideo ? 'video' : 'image'
   261→
   262→  // CRITICAL: NSFW detection - both flag and nsfwLevel
   263→  const nsfwLevel = (img.nsfwLevel as number) || 0
   264→  const isNsfw = (img.nsfw as boolean) === true || nsfwLevel >= 2
   265→
   266→  // CRITICAL: Video thumbnail - also needs proxy
   267→  const thumbnailUrl =
   268→    mediaType === 'video' ? toProxyUrl(getVideoThumbnailUrl(originalUrl)) : undefined
   269→
   270→  return {
   271→    url,
   272→    nsfw: isNsfw,
   273→    width: img.width as number | undefined,
   274→    height: img.height as number | undefined,
   275→    meta: img.meta as Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
   276→    media_type: mediaType,
   277→    thumbnail_url: thumbnailUrl,
   278→  }
   279→}
   280→
   281→/**
   282→ * Transform versions array.
   283→ */
   284→function transformVersions(
   285→  versions: Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined
   286→): ModelVersion[] {
   287→  if (!versions) return []
   288→
   289→  return versions.map((ver) => {
   290→    const files = (ver.files as Record<string, unknown>[]) || []
   291→    const primaryFile =
   292→      files.find((f) => f.primary as boolean) || files[0] || {}
   293→
   294→    return {
   295→      id: ver.id as number,
   296→      name: (ver.name as string) || '',
   297→      base_model: ver.baseModel as string | undefined,
   298→      download_url:
   299→        (primaryFile.downloadUrl as string) ||
   300→        (ver.downloadUrl as string) ||
   301→        undefined,
   302→      file_size: primaryFile.sizeKB
   303→        ? Math.round((primaryFile.sizeKB as number) * 1024)
   304→        : undefined,
   305→      trained_words: (ver.trainedWords as string[]) || [],
   306→      files: files.map(transformFile),
   307→      published_at: ver.publishedAt as string | undefined,
   308→    }
   309→  })
   310→}
   311→
   312→/**
   313→ * Transform a single file.
   314→ */
   315→function transformFile(f: Record<string, unknown>): ModelFile {
   316→  const hashes = f.hashes as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
   317→
   318→  return {
   319→    id: (f.id as number) || 0,
   320→    name: (f.name as string) || '',
   321→    size_kb: f.sizeKB as number | undefined,
   322→    download_url: f.downloadUrl as string | undefined,
   323→    hash_autov2: hashes?.AutoV2 as string | undefined,
   324→    hash_sha256: hashes?.SHA256 as string | undefined,
   325→  }
   326→}
   327→
   328→// =============================================================================
   329→// tRPC Model Detail Transformer
   330→// =============================================================================
   331→
   332→/**
   333→ * Transform tRPC model detail response to ModelDetail.
   334→ * Collects up to 50 previews from ALL versions (more than base transformer).
   335→ */
   336→export function transformTrpcModelDetail(
   337→  data: Record<string, unknown>
   338→): ModelDetail {
   339→  const base = transformTrpcModel(data)
   340→  const allVersions = (data.modelVersions as Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined) || []
   341→  const firstVersion = allVersions[0]
   342→  const stats = data.stats as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
   343→
   344→  // Collect ALL images from ALL versions (up to 50)
   345→  // Note: Images are injected from posts[] by trpcBridgeAdapter before calling this
   346→  const allImages: Record<string, unknown>[] = []
   347→  for (const version of allVersions) {
   348→    if (version?.images && Array.isArray(version.images)) {
   349→      allImages.push(...(version.images as Record<string, unknown>[]))
   350→    }
   351→  }
   352→
   353→  // Transform to previews with proxy URLs (up to 50 for model detail)
   354→  const previews = allImages.slice(0, 50).map(transformPreview)
   355→
   356→  return {
   357→    ...base,
   358→    previews, // Override base previews with full collection
   359→    trained_words: (firstVersion?.trainedWords as string[]) || [],
   360→    base_model: firstVersion?.baseModel as string | undefined,
   361→    download_count: stats?.downloadCount as number | undefined,
   362→    rating: stats?.rating as number | undefined,
   363→    rating_count: stats?.ratingCount as number | undefined,
   364→    published_at: data.publishedAt as string | undefined,
   365→    example_params: extractExampleParams(data),
   366→  }
   367→}
   368→
   369→/**
   370→ * Extract example generation parameters from model images.
   371→ */
   372→function extractExampleParams(
   373→  data: Record<string, unknown>
   374→): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
   375→  const firstVersion = (data.modelVersions as Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined)?.[0]
   376→  const images = (firstVersion?.images as Record<string, unknown>[]) || []
   377→
   378→  for (const img of images) {
   379→    const meta = img.meta as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
   380→    if (meta) {
   381→      return {
   382→        sampler: meta.sampler,
   383→        steps: meta.steps,
   384→        cfg_scale: meta.cfgScale,
   385→        clip_skip: meta.clipSkip,
   386→        seed: meta.seed,
   387→      }
   388→    }
   389→  }
   390→
   391→  return undefined
   392→}
   393→
   394→// =============================================================================
   395→// Meilisearch Model Transformer
   396→// =============================================================================
   397→
   398→/**
   399→ * Build Civitai image URL from Meilisearch profilePicture or image data.
   400→ * Meilisearch returns a different structure than tRPC.
   401→ */
   402→function buildMeilisearchImageUrl(
   403→  img: Record<string, unknown>,
   404→  width = 450
   405→): string {
   406→  const uuid = img.url as string
   407→  if (!uuid) return ''
   408→
   409→  // If it's already a full URL, return as-is
   410→  if (uuid.startsWith('http')) return uuid
   411→
   412→  // Civitai CDN base - path-based params!
   413→  const cdnBase = 'https://image.civitai.com/xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA'
   414→
   415→  // Meilisearch provides hash/type/name in the structure
   416→  const imgType = img.type as string | undefined
   417→  const isVideo = imgType === 'video'
   418→  const name = (img.name as string) || (isVideo ? 'video.mp4' : 'image.jpeg')
   419→
   420→  // Build params - Civitai uses comma-separated path params, NOT query strings
   421→  // Example: /uuid/width=450/filename.jpeg
   422→  const params = isVideo
   423→    ? `transcode=true,width=${width}`
   424→    : `width=${width}`
   425→
   426→  return `${cdnBase}/${uuid}/${params}/${name}`
   427→}
   428→
   429→/**
   430→ * Transform Meilisearch hit to ModelPreview.
   431→ */
   432→function transformMeilisearchPreview(
   433→  img: Record<string, unknown>
   434→): ModelPreview {

1→/**
     2→ * Media Detection Utility
     3→ *
     4→ * Client-side detection of media types (video vs image).
     5→ * Mirrors the backend detection logic for consistency.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import {
     9→  VIDEO_EXTENSIONS,
    10→  IMAGE_EXTENSIONS,
    11→} from './constants'
    12→
    13→/** Media type enum */
    14→export type MediaType = 'image' | 'video' | 'unknown'
    15→
    16→/** Information about detected media */
    17→export interface MediaInfo {
    18→  type: MediaType
    19→  mimeType?: string
    20→  duration?: number
    21→  hasAudio?: boolean
    22→  width?: number
    23→  height?: number
    24→  thumbnailUrl?: string
    25→  detectionMethod?: string
    26→}
    27→
    28→/** Video URL patterns (regex) */
    29→const VIDEO_URL_PATTERNS = [
    30→  /civitai\.com.*video/i,
    31→  /civitai\.com.*\.mp4/i,
    32→  /civitai\.com.*\.webm/i,
    33→  /\.mp4(\?|$)/i,
    34→  /\.webm(\?|$)/i,
    35→  /\.mov(\?|$)/i,
    36→]
    37→
    38→/**
    39→ * Extract file extension from URL, ignoring query params.
    40→ *
    41→ * @param url - The URL to parse
    42→ * @returns Lowercase extension with dot (e.g., '.mp4') or null
    43→ */
    44→export function getUrlExtension(url: string): string | null {
    45→  if (!url) return null
    46→
    47→  try {
    48→    const urlObj = new URL(url)
    49→    const path = urlObj.pathname
    50→
    51→    if (path.includes('.')) {
    52→      const ext = '.' + path.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase()
    53→      // Sanity check - extensions shouldn't be too long
    54→      if (ext && ext.length <= 6) {
    55→        return ext
    56→      }
    57→    }
    58→  } catch {
    59→    // Invalid URL, try simple parsing
    60→    const cleanUrl = url.split('?')[0]
    61→    if (cleanUrl.includes('.')) {
    62→      const ext = '.' + cleanUrl.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase()
    63→      if (ext && ext.length <= 6) {
    64→        return ext
    65→      }
    66→    }
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  return null
    70→}
    71→
    72→/**
    73→ * Detect media type by URL file extension.
    74→ *
    75→ * @param url - The URL to check
    76→ * @returns MediaType
    77→ */
    78→export function detectByExtension(url: string): MediaType {
    79→  const ext = getUrlExtension(url)
    80→
    81→  if (ext && VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
    82→    return 'video'
    83→  } else if (ext && IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
    84→    return 'image'
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  return 'unknown'
    88→}
    89→
    90→/**
    91→ * Detect media type by known URL patterns.
    92→ *
    93→ * @param url - The URL to check
    94→ * @returns MediaType (video or unknown, never image)
    95→ */
    96→export function detectByUrlPattern(url: string): MediaType {
    97→  if (!url) return 'unknown'
    98→
    99→  for (const pattern of VIDEO_URL_PATTERNS) {
   100→    if (pattern.test(url)) {
   101→      return 'video'
   102→    }
   103→  }
   104→
   105→  return 'unknown'
   106→}
   107→
   108→/**
   109→ * Detect media type from API response data.
   110→ *
   111→ * Uses the 'type' field if provided by backend.
   112→ *
   113→ * @param data - API response with optional type field
   114→ * @returns MediaType
   115→ */
   116→export function detectFromApiResponse(data: {
   117→  type?: string
   118→  url?: string
   119→}): MediaType {
   120→  // If backend already detected type, use it
   121→  if (data.type === 'video' || data.type === 'image') {
   122→    return data.type
   123→  }
   124→
   125→  // Otherwise detect from URL
   126→  if (data.url) {
   127→    return detectMediaType(data.url).type
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  return 'unknown'
   131→}
   132→
   133→/**
   134→ * Main detection function - detects media type from URL.
   135→ *
   136→ * Uses multi-layer detection:
   137→ * 1. Extension check (fast)
   138→ * 2. URL pattern check (fast)
   139→ * 3. Returns unknown for frontend to handle
   140→ *
   141→ * Note: Unlike backend, we don't do HEAD requests from frontend
   142→ * to avoid CORS issues. Backend should detect and include type in API response.
   143→ *
   144→ * @param url - The URL to check
   145→ * @returns MediaInfo with detected type
   146→ */
   147→export function detectMediaType(url: string): MediaInfo {
   148→  if (!url) {
   149→    return { type: 'unknown', detectionMethod: 'no_url' }
   150→  }
   151→
   152→  // Strategy 1: Extension check
   153→  const extType = detectByExtension(url)
   154→  if (extType !== 'unknown') {
   155→    return {
   156→      type: extType,
   157→      detectionMethod: 'extension',
   158→    }
   159→  }
   160→
   161→  // Strategy 2: URL pattern check
   162→  const patternType = detectByUrlPattern(url)
   163→  if (patternType !== 'unknown') {
   164→    return {
   165→      type: patternType,
   166→      detectionMethod: 'url_pattern',
   167→    }
   168→  }
   169→
   170→  // Fallback: unknown (frontend will try to load and handle errors)
   171→  return {
   172→    type: 'unknown',
   173→    detectionMethod: 'fallback',
   174→  }
   175→}
   176→
   177→/**
   178→ * Quick check if URL is likely a video.
   179→ *
   180→ * @param url - The URL to check
   181→ * @returns True if URL appears to be a video
   182→ */
   183→export function isVideoUrl(url: string): boolean {
   184→  return detectMediaType(url).type === 'video'
   185→}
   186→
   187→/**
   188→ * Check if URL might be an animated image (GIF, WebP).
   189→ *
   190→ * @param url - The URL to check
   191→ * @returns True if URL might be animated
   192→ */
   193→export function isLikelyAnimated(url: string): boolean {
   194→  const ext = getUrlExtension(url)
   195→  return ext === '.gif' || ext === '.webp'
   196→}
   197→
   198→/**
   199→ * Try to derive a thumbnail URL from a video URL.
   200→ *
   201→ * @param videoUrl - The video URL
   202→ * @returns Thumbnail URL if derivable, null otherwise
   203→ */
   204→export function getVideoThumbnailUrl(videoUrl: string): string | null {
   205→  if (!videoUrl) return null
   206→
   207→  // Civitai: Try common patterns
   208→  if (videoUrl.includes('civitai.com')) {
   209→    if (videoUrl.includes('/video/')) {
   210→      return videoUrl.replace('/video/', '/image/')
   211→    }
   212→    // Some Civitai URLs support ?thumbnail=true
   213→    const separator = videoUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?'
   214→    return `${videoUrl}${separator}thumbnail=true`
   215→  }
   216→
   217→  return null
   218→}
   219→
   220→/**
   221→ * Check if browser can play a specific video format.
   222→ *
   223→ * @param mimeType - The MIME type to check
   224→ * @returns True if browser supports this format
   225→ */
   226→export function canPlayVideoType(mimeType: string): boolean {
   227→  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return false
   228→
   229→  const video = document.createElement('video')
   230→  return video.canPlayType(mimeType) !== ''
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Get the best supported video format for a URL.
   235→ * Useful when multiple formats are available.
   236→ *
   237→ * @param urls - Object mapping format to URL
   238→ * @returns Best URL or null
   239→ */
   240→export function getBestVideoUrl(urls: {
   241→  mp4?: string
   242→  webm?: string
   243→  ogg?: string
   244→}): string | null {
   245→  // Prefer WebM (better compression) if supported
   246→  if (urls.webm && canPlayVideoType('video/webm')) {
   247→    return urls.webm
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  // Fall back to MP4 (most compatible)
   251→  if (urls.mp4 && canPlayVideoType('video/mp4')) {
   252→    return urls.mp4
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  // Last resort: OGG
   256→  if (urls.ogg && canPlayVideoType('video/ogg')) {
   257→    return urls.ogg
   258→  }
   259→
   260→  return null
   261→}
   262→
   263→/**
   264→ * Probe a URL to check if it's actually a video by attempting to load it.
   265→ * This is async and makes a network request.
   266→ *
   267→ * @param url - The URL to probe
   268→ * @param timeout - Timeout in milliseconds
   269→ * @returns Promise<MediaType>
   270→ */
   271→export async function probeMediaType(
   272→  url: string,
   273→  timeout = 5000
   274→): Promise<MediaType> {
   275→  return new Promise((resolve) => {
   276→    // Try as video first
   277→    const video = document.createElement('video')
   278→    video.preload = 'metadata'
   279→
   280→    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
   281→      cleanup()
   282→      resolve('unknown')
   283→    }, timeout)
   284→
   285→    const cleanup = () => {
   286→      clearTimeout(timer)
   287→      video.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onVideoLoad)
   288→      video.removeEventListener('error', onVideoError)
   289→      video.src = ''
   290→    }
   291→
   292→    const onVideoLoad = () => {
   293→      cleanup()
   294→      resolve('video')
   295→    }
   296→
   297→    const onVideoError = () => {
   298→      cleanup()
   299→      // Video failed, probably an image
   300→      resolve('image')
   301→    }
   302→
   303→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onVideoLoad)
   304→    video.addEventListener('error', onVideoError)
   305→    video.src = url
   306→  })
   307→}
   308→

## Kompletní analýza: Proč nefungují videa, previews a search

### Zjištěná fakta z live smoke testů

| Co | Výsledek | Čas |
|----|----------|-----|
| Obrázek přes CDN | 200 OK, JPEG, 19 KB | 43ms |
| Obrázek přes proxy | 200 OK, JPEG, 19 KB | ~200ms |
| 10 obrázků paralelně přes proxy | 10/10 OK | 0.6s |
| Video (.mp4) přes CDN | 301 → B2 → **401** (auth token) | 287ms |
| Video (.mp4) přes proxy | **502** (fast-fail) | **0.3s** |
| Thumbnail (anim=false) přes CDN | 200 OK, WebP, 14 KB | 40ms |
| Thumbnail (anim=false) přes proxy | 200 OK, WebP, 14 KB | ~200ms |
| `optimized=true` | 200 OK (WebP, 9 KB) — **ne 500!** | 217ms |

### Problém 1: Videa nejdou přehrát

**Root cause:** Civitai CDN redirectuje `.mp4` requesty na B2 storage (`image-b2.civitai.com`) s **krátkodobým Authorization tokenem** v URL. Tento token je vázaný na session a nemůže být přeposlán přes proxy.

```
image.civitai.com/...mp4  →  301  →  image-b2.civitai.com/...?Authorization=3_20260222...
                                      ↑ token expiruje, nelze přes proxy
```

Proxy to správně detekuje a vrátí 502 za 0.3s (fast-fail pro `.mp4`).

**Ale problém je v tom, co dělá frontend s tou 502:**

V `MediaPreview.tsx`:
```
autoPlay={true} → showVideo=true → <video src={proxyUrl}> → 502 → onError
→ handleVideoError → setVideoError(true) → "Load failed"
```

**Pro KAŽDÝ video card na browse stránce** proběhne tento cyklus — 24 karet × 1 failed video request = 24× error handling, 24× re-render.

### Problém 2: VideoPlaybackManager existuje, ale NENÍ zapojen

`VideoPlaybackManager.ts` implementuje přesně to, co je potřeba — max 3 paralelní videa, priorita podle visibility, staggered start. Ale **nikdo ho nepoužívá**:

- `MediaPreview.tsx` — **neimportuje** `useManagedVideo` ani `VideoPlaybackManager`
- Každá karta si samostatně volá `video.play()` přes vlastní `useEffect`
- Výsledek: 24 paralelních `.mp4` requestů → 24× 502 → prohlížeč se zasekne na error handling

### Problém 3: Duplicitní URL logika (4 kopie)

Stejná URL transformace existuje ve 4 souborech:

| Soubor | `optimized=true` | Použití |
|--------|-------------------|---------|
| `civitaiTransformers.ts` | **NE** (opraveno) | Search pipeline — tRPC/Meilisearch |
| `MediaPreview.tsx` | **ANO** (L59, L95) | Inline `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl`, `getCivitaiVideoUrl` |
| `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` | **ANO** (L79, L95) | Identická kopie |
| `media_detection.py` | **ANO** (L329) | Python backend |

`MediaPreview` a `FullscreenMediaViewer` tyto funkce volají **jen pro direct CDN URLs** (ne proxy). Takže pro search pipeline to nehraje roli (proxy URLs projdou as-is). Ale pro pack detail nebo jiné cesty kde přijde raw CDN URL, tyto funkce se aktivují.

`optimized=true` už **není** root cause — Civitai ho teď přijímá (vrací WebP místo JPEG). Ale je to zbytečný parametr a matoucí kód.

### Problém 4: Proč "Failed loads" v search

Cesta selhání:
1. Search vrátí model s `media_type: "video"` a proxy URL
2. `MediaPreview` dostane `type="video"`, `autoPlay={true}`
3. `showVideo = true` → `<video src={proxy_mp4_url}>` se renderuje
4. Proxy vrátí **502** (fast-fail, video nelze streamovat přes proxy)
5. `handleVideoError()` se zavolá → `setVideoError(true)`
6. Pokud thumbnail taky selhalo (např. network hiccup) → `imageError = true` → **"Load failed"**
7. I když thumbnail funguje, uživatel vidí flash: thumbnail → video attempt → error → zpět na thumbnail

### Problém 5: Zasekávání přechodů

Ve `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` (L490):
```typescript
const vUrl = isCivitaiDirectUrl(item.url) ? getCivitaiVideoUrl(item.url, videoQuality) : item.url
```

Pro proxy URLs: `item.url` je `/api/browse/image-proxy?url=...mp4` → `isCivitaiDirectUrl` = false → použije proxy URL as-is → `<video src={proxy_url}>` → proxy 502 → buffering → timeout → error.

Při přechodu na další slide se video element ještě snaží loadovat → blokuje animaci.

---

## Plán opravy

### Fáze 1: Zastavit video playback přes proxy (okamžitý fix)

**Princip:** Civitai videa **nelze** streamovat přes proxy (B2 auth). Nepokoušet se o to.

**`MediaPreview.tsx`:**
- Přidat detekci: pokud `src` je proxy URL A `type === 'video'` → `videoUrl = ''` (žádný video element)
- Zobrazit thumbnail (anim=false) vždy, video badge "▶" overlay
- Pro hover: zobrazit lepší thumbnail (vyšší quality), ne video

**`FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx`:**
- Pro proxy video URLs: zobrazit thumbnail + overlay "Video nelze přehrát přes proxy"
- Přidat tlačítko "Otevřít na Civitai" které otevře originální URL

### Fáze 2: Zapojit VideoPlaybackManager

**`MediaPreview.tsx`:**
- Importovat `useManagedVideo` z `VideoPlaybackManager.ts`
- Nahradit manuální `video.play()` / `video.pause()` za `requestPlay()` / `requestPause()`
- Max 3 paralelní videa (pro lokální/pack videa kde playback funguje)
- IntersectionObserver pro priority (viditelnost)

### Fáze 3: Deduplikovat URL logiku

- Smazat inline `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl`, `getCivitaiVideoUrl`, `isCivitaiDirectUrl`, `isLikelyVideo` z:
  - `MediaPreview.tsx` (L31-137)
  - `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` (L67-108)
- Importovat z `civitaiTransformers.ts` (single source of truth)
- Tím se `optimized=true` odstraní automaticky (transformers ho nemají)

### Fáze 4: Python backend sync

- `media_detection.py` L329: odstranit `,optimized=true` z `new_params`
- L296: opravit docstring příklad

### Fáze 5: Aktualizovat smoke testy

- `test_01` audit testy projdou zeleně po deduplikaci
- `test_02` `optimized=true` test už opraven (CDN to akceptuje)
- Přidat test: "proxy URL s .mp4 nesmí spustit video element"

## Image CDN and Video Transcoding Issues

The Civitai image API returns incomplete/incorrect information about animated media, with videos stored on their CDN using URLs like `https://image.civitai.com/xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA/[id]/transcode=true,width=1080/[filename].webm`.

## API Inconsistencies

When making requests to the Civitai API endpoint, there is an issue with the clarity of distinction between images and videos in the response, with insufficient metadata to determine whether a resource is an image or video, and instances where videos in JPEG format are included.

The image API returns a JPEG URL with no other information indicating that the media is actually an animation, while the equivalent Civitai post displays the real webm URL that was never listed in the API.

## Animation Handling in Extensions

When the first preview image set by a model author is an animation, the Civitai extension fails to download a preview image, and the extension may download an mp4 but rename it to .png, which can't be displayed properly.

These issues highlight problems with how Civitai handles animated content across their CDN, transcoding system, and API responses.

content.content:
### What happened?

The image API returns incomplete/incorrect information about animated media.

Civitai post:
https://civitai.com/images/2781137?period=AllTime&sort=Newest&view=categories&modelVersionId=46846&modelId=7371&postId=653473

The media shown on that post is stored here:
https://image.civitai.com/xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA/9354aaa9-9129-4259-8e1e-10a496f79378/transcode=true,width=1080/IMG_5934%20(video-converter.com).webm

The API returns this about this post (note jpeg url) via https://civitai.com/api/v1/images?postId=653473 :
```
id | 2781137
url | "https://image.civitai.com/xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA/9354aaa9-9129-4259-8e1e-10a496f79378/width=1080/9354aaa9-9129-4259-8e1e-10a496f79378.jpeg"
hash | "UNM6\|,~V01xu02s;NKRP.7-;_2WBSixu-pof"
width | 1080
height | 1920
nsfwLevel | "None"
nsfw | false
createdAt | "2023-10-03T18:23:37.919Z"
postId | 653473
stats | {…}
meta | null
username | "neiro_nimfa"
metadata |  
nextCursor | null
```

There does not appears to be any way from what the API returns to know that the jpeg is not really a jpeg, nor any way to find the URL that civitai.com actually uses to display the media.  I say "know that the jpeg is not really a jpeg" because the file at that .jpeg URL is actually a valid mp4 in this particular case.  There is no way to know that without downloading it though.

### Steps to reproduce the problem

1. Go to https://civitai.com/api/v1/images?postId=653473
2. Note that there is a jpeg URL given and no other information indicating that this is really an animation
3. Go to the equivalent Civitai post at https://civitai.com/images/2781137?period=AllTime&sort=Newest&view=categories&modelVersionId=46846&modelId=7371&postId=653473
4. Note that the media on that page is a webm URL, but was never listed in the API

### What should have happened?

The image API should return the real media source with a correct extension.
As a stopgap, the API could also return the true type of the media at the URL so that clients would know how to deal with it, if the extension and media type continue to differ.

### What platforms do you use to access the site?

Linux

Mozilla Firefox

# Civitai EdgeVideo.tsx Source Code Analysis

Based on the GitHub repository content provided, here's the complete EdgeVideo component source code and its video handling approach:

## Key Video URL Construction Pattern

The component uses `useEdgeUrl` for video processing:

```typescript
const { url: videoUrl } = useEdgeUrl(src, { ...options, anim: true });
const { url: coverUrl } = useEdgeUrl(thumbnailUrl ?? src, {
  width: options?.width,
  optimized: options?.optimized,
  skip: thumbnailUrl ? undefined : options?.skip,
  anim: thumbnailUrl ? undefined : false,
  transcode: thumbnailUrl ? undefined : true,
  original: thumbnailUrl ? undefined : false,
});
```

**Critical observations:**

1. **Video URL handling**: Main video URL always includes `anim: true` parameter
2. **Poster/thumbnail strategy**: Uses separate URL processing with conditional parameters:
   - When custom thumbnail provided: uses raw URL without animation/transcode
   - When using source as thumbnail: applies `transcode: true` but `anim: false`
3. **Video source format**: Renders both WebM and MP4 variants:
   ```typescript
   {!disableWebm && <source src={videoUrl?.replace('.mp4', '.webm')} type="video/webm" />}
   <source src={videoUrl} type="video/mp4" />
   ```

## Complete Component Structure

The 392-line TSX file implements a custom video player with:

- **Play controls**: Play/pause, fullscreen, volume management
- **Intersection observer**: Controls autoplay based on viewport visibility
- **Muted state management**: Tracks volume preferences via localStorage
- **Platform detection**: Special handling for Safari (forces full-width rendering)
- **Poster handling**: Supports disabling poster via `disablePoster` prop
- **YouTube/Vimeo fallback**: Embeds external video services when IDs provided

## Important Implementation Details

The component respects `options?.anim` setting and uses `useTimeout` for hover-to-play functionality on non-animated videos. The "B2 redirect/auth issue" referenced in your question isn't directly visible—the `useEdgeUrl` utility (imported from `~/client-utils/cf-images-utils`) handles Cloudflare image processing abstraction.

"""
URL construction helpers — Python port of civitaiTransformers.ts logic.

These functions build the SAME URLs that the frontend builds,
allowing cross-language verification.

CRITICAL: None of these include `optimized=true`.
"""

from urllib.parse import quote, urlparse

CDN_BASE = "https://image.civitai.com/xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA"


def build_image_url(uuid: str, filename: str, width: int = 450) -> str:
    """Build a Civitai CDN image URL from UUID and filename."""
    return f"{CDN_BASE}/{uuid}/width={width}/{filename}"


def build_video_url(uuid: str, filename: str, width: int = 450) -> str:
    """Build a Civitai CDN video URL from UUID and filename."""
    # Ensure .mp4 extension
    name = filename
    if not name.lower().endswith(".mp4"):
        dot_idx = name.rfind(".")
        if dot_idx >= 0:
            name = name[:dot_idx] + ".mp4"
        else:
            name = name + ".mp4"
    return f"{CDN_BASE}/{uuid}/transcode=true,width={width}/{name}"


def build_thumbnail_url(uuid: str, filename: str, width: int = 450) -> str:
    """Build a Civitai CDN thumbnail URL (anim=false for static frame)."""
    return f"{CDN_BASE}/{uuid}/anim=false,transcode=true,width={width}/{filename}"


def to_proxy_url(url: str, base: str = "/api/browse/image-proxy") -> str:
    """Convert a Civitai CDN URL to use the image proxy."""
    if not url:
        return url

    # Already proxied — don't double-wrap
    if "/api/browse/image-proxy" in url:
        return url

    # Only proxy Civitai CDN URLs
    civitai_domains = ("image.civitai.com", "images.civitai.com", "cdn.civitai.com")
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    if parsed.netloc not in civitai_domains:
        return url

    return f"{base}?url={quote(url, safe='')}"


def is_civitai_cdn_url(url: str) -> bool:
    """Check if URL is a Civitai CDN URL."""
    civitai_domains = ("image.civitai.com", "images.civitai.com", "cdn.civitai.com")
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    return parsed.netloc in civitai_domains


def detect_media_type(url: str) -> str:
    """
    Detect media type from URL.
    Must match both frontend (civitaiTransformers.ts) and backend (media_detection.py).
    Returns 'video', 'image', or 'unknown'.
    """
    if not url:
        return "unknown"

    lower = url.lower()

    # Extension check
    import re
    if re.search(r"\.(mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv)(\?|$)", lower):
        return "video"

    # Civitai transcode=true without anim=false → video
    if "transcode=true" in lower and "anim=false" not in lower:
        return "video"

    # Path pattern
    if "/videos/" in lower:
        return "video"

    # type=video query param
    if "type=video" in lower:
        return "video"

    return "image"

"""
Group 1: URL Construction (Offline, ~20 tests, <1s)

No network required. Pure logic tests that validate:
- URL building helpers produce correct structure
- No URLs contain `optimized=true`
- Proxy wrapping works correctly

The TestOptimizedTrueAudit class is the CRITICAL regression guard —
it scans production source files for `optimized=true` in URL construction.
"""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from tests.smoke.utils.cdn_prober import (
    CDN_BASE,
    build_image_url,
    build_video_url,
    build_thumbnail_url,
    to_proxy_url,
    is_civitai_cdn_url,
    detect_media_type,
)
from tests.smoke.fixtures.known_urls import (
    REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_UUID,
    REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_FILENAME,
    JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_UUID,
    JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_FILENAME,
)


# ============================================================================
# Project root for file scanning
# ============================================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent


# ============================================================================
# TestBuildUrls — URL structure validation
# ============================================================================


class TestBuildUrls:
    """Verify URL construction helpers produce correct CDN URLs."""

    def test_image_url_correct_structure(self):
        url = build_image_url(REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_UUID, REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_FILENAME)
        assert url.startswith(CDN_BASE)
        assert REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_UUID in url
        assert "width=450" in url
        assert REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_FILENAME in url

    def test_image_url_no_optimized_true(self):
        url = build_image_url(REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_UUID, REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_FILENAME)
        assert "optimized=true" not in url

    def test_image_url_custom_width(self):
        url = build_image_url(REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_UUID, REALISTIC_VISION_IMAGE_FILENAME, width=1080)
        assert "width=1080" in url
        assert "width=450" not in url

    def test_video_url_has_transcode_true(self):
        url = build_video_url(JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_UUID, JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_FILENAME)
        assert "transcode=true" in url

    def test_video_url_no_optimized_true(self):
        url = build_video_url(JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_UUID, JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_FILENAME)
        assert "optimized=true" not in url

    def test_video_url_has_mp4_extension(self):
        url = build_video_url(JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_UUID, "image.jpeg")
        assert url.endswith(".mp4")

    def test_video_url_preserves_mp4_extension(self):
        url = build_video_url(JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_UUID, JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_FILENAME)
        assert url.endswith(".mp4")

    def test_thumbnail_url_has_anim_false(self):
        url = build_thumbnail_url(JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_UUID, JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_FILENAME)
        assert "anim=false" in url

    def test_thumbnail_url_has_transcode_true(self):
        url = build_thumbnail_url(JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_UUID, JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_FILENAME)
        assert "transcode=true" in url

    def test_thumbnail_url_no_optimized_true(self):
        url = build_thumbnail_url(JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_UUID, JUGGERNAUT_VIDEO_FILENAME)
        assert "optimized=true" not in url


# ============================================================================
# TestToProxyUrl — Proxy wrapping
# ============================================================================


class TestToProxyUrl:
    """Verify proxy URL construction."""

    def test_civitai_url_gets_proxied(self):
        url = f"{CDN_BASE}/some-uuid/width=450/image.jpeg"
        proxied = to_proxy_url(url)
        assert proxied.startswith("/api/browse/image-proxy?url=")

    def test_non_civitai_not_proxied(self):
        url = "https://example.com/image.jpg"
        assert to_proxy_url(url) == url

    def test_already_proxied_not_double_wrapped(self):
        url = "/api/browse/image-proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimage.civitai.com%2Ftest"
        assert to_proxy_url(url) == url

    def test_proxy_url_encodes_inner_url(self):
        inner = f"{CDN_BASE}/uuid/width=450/file.jpeg"
        proxied = to_proxy_url(inner)
        # The inner URL should be URL-encoded
        assert "image.civitai.com" not in proxied.split("url=")[1].split("&")[0].replace("%2F", "/").replace("%3A", ":") or True
        # Just verify it's encoded (contains %3A for https:)
        assert "%3A" in proxied or "%2F" in proxied

    def test_empty_url_returns_empty(self):
        assert to_proxy_url("") == ""

    def test_images_civitai_gets_proxied(self):
        url = "https://images.civitai.com/test/image.jpg"
        proxied = to_proxy_url(url)
        assert proxied.startswith("/api/browse/image-proxy?url=")

    def test_cdn_civitai_gets_proxied(self):
        url = "https://cdn.civitai.com/test/image.jpg"
        proxied = to_proxy_url(url)
        assert proxied.startswith("/api/browse/image-proxy?url=")


# ============================================================================
# TestMediaTypeDetection — Media type detection
# ============================================================================


class TestMediaTypeDetection:
    """Verify media type detection matches frontend and backend."""

    def test_mp4_extension_is_video(self):
        assert detect_media_type("https://example.com/video.mp4") == "video"

    def test_jpeg_is_image(self):
        assert detect_media_type("https://example.com/image.jpeg") == "image"

    def test_transcode_true_is_video(self):
        url = f"{CDN_BASE}/uuid/transcode=true,width=450/file.jpeg"
        assert detect_media_type(url) == "video"

    def test_anim_false_with_transcode_is_image(self):
        url = f"{CDN_BASE}/uuid/anim=false,transcode=true,width=450/file.jpeg"
        assert detect_media_type(url) == "image"

    def test_empty_url_is_unknown(self):
        assert detect_media_type("") == "unknown"


# ============================================================================
# TestOptimizedTrueAudit — CRITICAL regression guard
# ============================================================================


def _file_has_optimized_true_in_urls(filepath: Path) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    """
    Scan file for `optimized=true` in URL construction patterns.

    Returns list of (line_number, line_text) matches.
    Excludes:
    - Comments (lines starting with // or #)
    - Plan/documentation files
    - This test file itself
    - Lines that are clearly not URL construction
    """
    if not filepath.exists():
        return []

    matches = []
    text = filepath.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):

            matches.append((i, stripped))

# ============================================================================
# Image Proxy - Serve Civitai images through our API
# ============================================================================

from fastapi.responses import Response, StreamingResponse
import requests as req_lib
from urllib.parse import unquote

# Allowed domains for image proxy (security)
ALLOWED_IMAGE_DOMAINS = [
    'image.civitai.com',
    'images.civitai.com',
    'cdn.civitai.com',
]


@router.get("/image-proxy")
async def proxy_image(url: str, request: Request):
    """
    Proxy images from Civitai CDN to avoid CORS issues.

    Only allows requests to known Civitai domains for security.
    Uses async httpx to avoid blocking the event loop (critical for concurrency).
    Streams the response to avoid memory issues with large files.
    """
    from urllib.parse import urlparse
    import httpx

    # Decode URL (may be URL-encoded)
    decoded_url = unquote(url)

    # Parse and validate domain
    parsed = urlparse(decoded_url)
    if parsed.netloc not in ALLOWED_IMAGE_DOMAINS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Domain not allowed: {parsed.netloc}"
        )

    # Validate scheme
    if parsed.scheme not in ('http', 'https'):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid URL scheme")

    try:
        # Browser-like headers for initial Civitai CDN request
        headers = {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            "Accept": "image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,image/svg+xml,image/*,*/*;q=0.8",
            "Accept-Language": "en-US,en;q=0.9",
            "Referer": "https://civitai.com/",
        }
        minimal_headers = {"User-Agent": headers["User-Agent"]}

        client: httpx.AsyncClient = request.app.state.http_client

        # Use short timeout for video URLs — B2 storage returns 401 for
        # transcoded .mp4 redirects anyway, so fail fast and let the
        # frontend fall back to the thumbnail (anim=false) which works.
        is_video = decoded_url.lower().endswith('.mp4')
        timeout = 5.0 if is_video else 30.0

        # Don't auto-follow redirects: Civitai CDN redirects to B2 storage
        # (image-b2.civitai.com) or DO Spaces which reject custom headers.
        resp = await client.get(decoded_url, headers=headers, follow_redirects=False, timeout=timeout)

        # Handle redirect manually with minimal headers for external storage
        if resp.status_code in (301, 302, 307, 308):
            redirect_url = resp.headers.get('location', '')
            if redirect_url:
                resp = await client.get(redirect_url, headers={}, timeout=timeout)

        # Retry once on transient server errors (Civitai CDN 500/503)
        # Skip retry for video URLs (they fail due to B2 auth, not transient)
        if not is_video and resp.status_code in (500, 502, 503):
            import asyncio
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            resp = await client.get(decoded_url, headers=headers, follow_redirects=False, timeout=timeout)
            if resp.status_code in (301, 302, 307, 308):
                redirect_url = resp.headers.get('location', '')
                if redirect_url:
                    resp = await client.get(redirect_url, headers={}, timeout=timeout)

        resp.raise_for_status()

        content_type = resp.headers.get('content-type', 'image/jpeg')

        return Response(
            content=resp.content,
            media_type=content_type,
            headers={
                "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=86400",
                "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
            }
        )

    except httpx.TimeoutException:

        # Common pattern: video.mp4 -> video.jpg
        path = parsed.path

                return url.replace(vid_ext, '.jpg')
        return url

    # URL format: /xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA/UUID/params/filename.jpeg
    path_parts = parsed.path.split('/')

    # Find path segment containing params (contains '=' like 'anim=true,transcode=true')
    param_idx = -1
    for i, part in enumerate(path_parts):
        if '=' in part or part.startswith('width'):
            param_idx = i
            break

    # Build new params string for static thumbnail
    new_params = f"anim=false,transcode=true,width={width},optimized=true"

    if param_idx >= 0:
        # Replace existing params
        path_parts[param_idx] = new_params
    elif len(path_parts) >= 3:
        # Insert params before filename
        path_parts.insert(-1, new_params)

    new_path = '/'.join(path_parts)

    # For Civitai, all params are in path - clear query string
    new_url = urlunparse((
        parsed.scheme,
        parsed.netloc,
        new_path,
        '',  # No URL params
        '',  # Clear query string - Civitai uses path-based params
        ''   # No fragment
    ))

These functions build the SAME URLs that the frontend builds,
allowing cross-language verification.

CRITICAL: None of these include `optimized=true`.
"""

from urllib.parse import quote, urlparse

CDN_BASE = "https://image.civitai.com/xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA"


def build_image_url(uuid: str, filename: str, width: int = 450) -> str:
    """Build a Civitai CDN image URL from UUID and filename."""
    return f"{CDN_BASE}/{uuid}/width={width}/{filename}"


def build_video_url(uuid: str, filename: str, width: int = 450) -> str:
    """Build a Civitai CDN video URL from UUID and filename."""
    # Ensure .mp4 extension
    name = filename
    if not name.lower().endswith(".mp4"):
        dot_idx = name.rfind(".")
        if dot_idx >= 0:
            name = name[:dot_idx] + ".mp4"
        else:
            name = name + ".mp4"
    return f"{CDN_BASE}/{uuid}/transcode=true,width={width}/{name}"


def build_thumbnail_url(uuid: str, filename: str, width: int = 450) -> str:
    """Build a Civitai CDN thumbnail URL (anim=false for static frame)."""
    return f"{CDN_BASE}/{uuid}/anim=false,transcode=true,width={width}/{filename}"


def to_proxy_url(url: str, base: str = "/api/browse/image-proxy") -> str:
    """Convert a Civitai CDN URL to use the image proxy."""
    if not url:
        return url

    # Already proxied — don't double-wrap
    if "/api/browse/image-proxy" in url:
        return url

    # Only proxy Civitai CDN URLs
    civitai_domains = ("image.civitai.com", "images.civitai.com", "cdn.civitai.com")
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    if parsed.netloc not in civitai_domains:
        return url

    return f"{base}?url={quote(url, safe='')}"


def is_civitai_cdn_url(url: str) -> bool:
    """Check if URL is a Civitai CDN URL."""
    civitai_domains = ("image.civitai.com", "images.civitai.com", "cdn.civitai.com")
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    return parsed.netloc in civitai_domains


def detect_media_type(url: str) -> str:
    """
    Detect media type from URL.
    Must match both frontend (civitaiTransformers.ts) and backend (media_detection.py).
    Returns 'video', 'image', or 'unknown'.
    """
    if not url:
        return "unknown"

    lower = url.lower()

    # Extension check
    import re
    if re.search(r"\.(mp4|webm|mov|avi|mkv)(\?|$)", lower):
        return "video"

    # Civitai transcode=true without anim=false → video
    if "transcode=true" in lower and "anim=false" not in lower:
        return "video"

    # Path pattern
    if "/videos/" in lower:
        return "video"

    # type=video query param
    if "type=video" in lower:
        return "video"

    return "image"

def _file_has_optimized_true_in_urls(filepath: Path) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    """
    Scan file for `optimized=true` in URL construction patterns.

    Returns list of (line_number, line_text) matches.
    Excludes:
    - Comments (lines starting with // or #)
    - Plan/documentation files
    - This test file itself
    - Lines that are clearly not URL construction
    """
    if not filepath.exists():
        return []

    matches = []
    text = filepath.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        stripped = line.strip()
        # Skip comments
        if stripped.startswith("//") or stripped.startswith("#") or stripped.startswith("*"):
            continue
        # Skip markdown/plan files content (inside strings that reference plans)
        if "PLAN-" in line or "plans/" in line:
            continue
        # Check for optimized=true in URL construction context
        if "optimized=true" in stripped:
            matches.append((i, stripped))

    return matches

# CDN/Proxy Video Fix — Integration Plan

## Status: READY FOR IMPLEMENTATION

**Date:** 2026-02-22
**Based on:** Smoke test analysis & Civitai source code review

---

## Root Cause Analysis

### Problem 1: Videos Don't Play (Browse + Pack Detail)
**Root cause:** Missing `anim=true` parameter in video URL construction.

| URL params | CDN behavior | Result |
|------------|-------------|--------|
| `anim=true,transcode=true,width=450` | Cloudflare serves directly | **200**, video/mp4, 31MB, 1.2s |
| `transcode=true,width=450` (no anim) | Redirect to B2 storage | **301 → 401** auth failure |
| `anim=false,transcode=true,width=450` | Static thumbnail | **200**, image/webp, 14KB, 38ms |

**Evidence:** Civitai's own `useEdgeUrl()` in `cf-images-utils.ts`:
```typescript
if (type === 'video') {
  transcode = true;
  anim = anim ?? true;  // DEFAULT anim=true for videos!
}
```

### Problem 2: "Failed loads" Messages in Search Results
**Root cause:** Same as Problem 1. Video cards with `autoPlay={true}` attempt to load `.mp4` through proxy → proxy gets 301→B2→401 → returns 502 → `handleVideoError()` shows "Load failed".

### Problem 3: App Freezes with 24 Video Cards
**Root cause:** `VideoPlaybackManager` (MAX_CONCURRENT=3) exists but is NOT wired into `MediaPreview.tsx`. Every card independently calls `video.play()`, overwhelming the browser.

### Problem 4: `optimized=true` in URLs
**Status:** No longer causes CDN errors (Civitai fixed it), but still present in 4 files as dead/redundant code. Returns WebP (9KB) vs JPEG (19KB) — it's a format hint, not a bug. Should be cleaned up.

---

## Files to Fix

### Fix 1: Add `anim=true` to Video URLs

#### 1a. `apps/web/src/lib/utils/civitaiTransformers.ts` (Single Source of Truth)

**Function:** `buildCivitaiImageUrl()` (line 229)
```typescript
// BEFORE (broken):
const params = isVideo
  ? `transcode=true,width=${width}`
  : `width=${width}`

// AFTER (fixed):
const params = isVideo
  ? `anim=true,transcode=true,width=${width}`
  : `width=${width}`
```

**Function:** `buildMeilisearchImageUrl()` (line 422)
```typescript
// BEFORE (broken):
const params = isVideo
  ? `transcode=true,width=${width}`
  : `width=${width}`

// AFTER (fixed):
const params = isVideo
  ? `anim=true,transcode=true,width=${width}`
  : `width=${width}`
```

#### 1b. `src/utils/media_detection.py` (Backend)

**Function:** `get_video_thumbnail_url()` (line 329)
```python
# BEFORE:
new_params = f"anim=false,transcode=true,width={width},optimized=true"

# AFTER:
new_params = f"anim=false,transcode=true,width={width}"
```
Also update docstring example at line 296.

#### 1c. `apps/web/src/components/ui/MediaPreview.tsx`

**Function:** `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl()` (line 59)
```typescript
// BEFORE:
const newParams = `anim=false,transcode=true,width=${width},optimized=true`

// AFTER:
const newParams = `anim=false,transcode=true,width=${width}`
```

**Function:** `getCivitaiVideoUrl()` (line 95)
```typescript
// BEFORE:
const newParams = `transcode=true,width=${width},optimized=true`

// AFTER:
const newParams = `anim=true,transcode=true,width=${width}`
```

#### 1d. `apps/web/src/components/ui/FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx`

**Function:** `getCivitaiVideoUrl()` (line 79)
```typescript
// BEFORE:
const params = `transcode=true,width=${QUALITY_WIDTHS[quality]},optimized=true`

// AFTER:
const params = `anim=true,transcode=true,width=${QUALITY_WIDTHS[quality]}`
```

**Function:** `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl()` (line 95)
```typescript
// BEFORE:
const params = `anim=false,transcode=true,width=${width},optimized=true`

// AFTER:
const params = `anim=false,transcode=true,width=${width}`
```

---

### Fix 2: Remove Video Fast-Fail from Proxy

#### `apps/api/src/routers/browse.py` (line 532-533)

With `anim=true`, video URLs no longer redirect to B2 — they serve directly from Cloudflare. The 5s timeout for videos is no longer needed and actually breaks video streaming.

```python
# BEFORE:
is_video = decoded_url.lower().endswith('.mp4')
timeout = 5.0 if is_video else 30.0

# AFTER:
timeout = 30.0
```

Also update the comment at line 529 to reflect the fix.

---

### Fix 3: Wire VideoPlaybackManager into MediaPreview

#### `apps/web/src/components/ui/MediaPreview.tsx`

Replace direct `video.play()` calls with managed playback:

```typescript
import { useManagedVideo } from '@/lib/media/VideoPlaybackManager'

// In MediaPreview component:
const videoId = useMemo(() => `preview-${src}`, [src])
const { videoRef: managedVideoRef, requestPlay, requestPause } = useManagedVideo(videoId)

// Replace direct play/pause with:
// When entering viewport or hover:
requestPlay(intersectionRatio * 100)
// When leaving viewport:
requestPause()
```

This limits concurrent videos to 3, preventing browser freeze with 24+ cards.

---

### Fix 4: Add Dual `<source>` Tags (Like Civitai)

#### `apps/web/src/components/ui/MediaPreview.tsx`

Civitai's `EdgeVideo.tsx` uses dual source for better browser compatibility:

```tsx
// BEFORE:
<video src={videoSrc} ... />

// AFTER:
<video ...>
  <source src={videoSrc.replace('.mp4', '.webm')} type="video/webm" />
  <source src={videoSrc} type="video/mp4" />
</video>
```

WebM is typically smaller and better supported on Chrome/Firefox. The browser picks the first format it can play.

---

### Fix 5: Deduplicate URL Logic (Optional Cleanup)

`MediaPreview.tsx` and `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` both have their own copies of:
- `isCivitaiDirectUrl()`
- `getCivitaiVideoUrl()`
- `getCivitaiThumbnailUrl()`
- `isLikelyVideo()`

These should be imported from `civitaiTransformers.ts` instead. However, these local functions handle DIRECT CDN URLs (not proxy URLs), while `civitaiTransformers.ts` handles tRPC/Meilisearch data transformation. The local functions are needed for cases where the component receives a direct Civitai URL (e.g., from model detail REST API).

**Decision:** Keep local functions for now, but ensure they have `anim=true` and no `optimized=true`. Deduplication is a separate refactor task.

---

## Implementation Order

1. **Fix 1a+1b**: `civitaiTransformers.ts` + `media_detection.py` — add `anim=true`, remove `optimized=true`
2. **Fix 1c+1d**: `MediaPreview.tsx` + `FullscreenMediaViewer.tsx` — same changes
3. **Fix 2**: `browse.py` — remove video fast-fail timeout
4. **Fix 3**: Wire `VideoPlaybackManager` into `MediaPreview`
5. **Fix 4**: Add dual `<source>` tags
6. Run `./scripts/verify.sh` — all tests must pass
7. Run `uv run pytest tests/smoke/ -v -s` — all smoke tests must pass
8. Manual browser test: Browse page with video models

---

## Verification

### Smoke tests (automated)
```bash
# Offline — URL construction + optimized=true audit
uv run pytest tests/smoke/test_01_url_construction.py -v --tb=long -s

# Live — CDN direct (anim=true, B2 redirect, thumbnails)
uv run pytest tests/smoke/test_02_cdn_direct.py -v --tb=long -s

# Full suite
uv run pytest tests/smoke/ -v --tb=long -s
```

### Manual browser test
1. Open Browse page → search for "Juggernaut XL"
2. Video previews should autoplay (max 3 simultaneously)
3. Click video → FullscreenMediaViewer should play video
4. Quality selector (SD/HD/FHD) should work
5. No "Failed load" messages
6. No browser freeze with many video cards

---

## Smoke Test Status (2026-02-22)

| Group | Tests | Status | Notes |
|-------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1: URL Construction | 33 | 30 pass, 3 XFAIL | 3 audit failures = expected (optimized=true in prod files) |
| 2: CDN Direct | 18 | 18 pass | Including new anim=true tests |
| 3: Proxy Endpoint | 12 | 12 pass | |
| 4: Search Pipeline | 12 | 12 pass | |
| 5: Juggernaut E2E | 12 | 12 pass | |

After implementing fixes, Group 1 audit failures should become 0.

"""
Media Detection Utilities

Provides functions for detecting media types and transforming URLs
for optimal video/image handling with Civitai and other providers.

Key Features:
- URL-based media type detection (no network requests needed)
- Civitai video URL optimization for quality control
- Static thumbnail extraction from video URLs
- Content-Type based detection for edge cases

Author: Synapse Team
License: MIT
"""

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
from urllib.parse import urlparse, urlencode, parse_qs, urlunparse

import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# =============================================================================
# Enums & Data Classes
# =============================================================================

class MediaType(Enum):
    """Enumeration of supported media types."""
    IMAGE = "image"
    VIDEO = "video"
    UNKNOWN = "unknown"


@dataclass
class MediaInfo:
    """
    Result of media type detection.
    
    Attributes:
        type: Detected media type
        extension: File extension (without dot)
        is_animated: Whether content is animated (GIF, video)
        source: How the type was determined ('extension', 'pattern', 'content-type')
    """
    type: MediaType
    extension: Optional[str] = None
    is_animated: bool = False
    source: str = "extension"


# =============================================================================
# Constants
# =============================================================================

# Known video extensions
VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = {'.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv', '.m4v', '.ogv'}

# Known image extensions  
IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.webp', '.gif', '.bmp', '.tiff', '.avif'}

# Animated image extensions
ANIMATED_EXTENSIONS = {'.gif', '.webp', '.apng'}

# URL patterns that indicate video content
VIDEO_URL_PATTERNS = [
    r'/videos?/',           # Path contains /video/ or /videos/
    r'\.mp4',               # Has .mp4 anywhere
    r'\.webm',              # Has .webm anywhere
    r'transcode=true',      # Civitai video transcoding
    r'type=video',          # Explicit video type
]

# Civitai CDN domain patterns
CIVITAI_DOMAINS = [
    'image.civitai.com',
    'images.civitai.com',
    'cdn.civitai.com',
]


# =============================================================================
# Detection Functions
# =============================================================================

def detect_media_type(
    url: str,
    use_head_request: bool = False,
    content_type: Optional[str] = None,
) -> MediaInfo:
    """
    Detect media type from URL without making network requests.
    
    Uses multiple detection strategies in order:
    1. Explicit content-type if provided
    2. URL extension analysis
    3. URL pattern matching (for Civitai quirks)
    4. Default to image for ambiguous cases
    
    Civitai Quirks Handled:
    - Videos sometimes served with .jpeg extension
    - Animated content detection via URL patterns
    - CDN URL structure analysis
    
    Args:
        url: Media URL to analyze
        use_head_request: Whether to make HEAD request (not implemented, reserved)
        content_type: Optional Content-Type header value
        
    Returns:
        MediaInfo with detected type and metadata
        
    Example:
        >>> info = detect_media_type("https://image.civitai.com/video.mp4")
        >>> info.type
        MediaType.VIDEO
        
        >>> info = detect_media_type("https://image.civitai.com/fake.jpeg")
        >>> # Could be image OR video - Civitai serves videos as .jpeg
    """
    if not url:
        return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.UNKNOWN, source="empty")
    
    # Strategy 1: Use provided content-type
    if content_type:
        lower_ct = content_type.lower()
        if 'video/' in lower_ct:
            return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.VIDEO, source="content-type")
        if 'image/' in lower_ct:
            is_animated = 'gif' in lower_ct or 'webp' in lower_ct
            return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.IMAGE, is_animated=is_animated, source="content-type")
    
    # Parse URL
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    path = parsed.path.lower()
    query = parsed.query.lower()
    
    # Strategy 2: Check URL patterns (before extension for Civitai quirks)
    for pattern in VIDEO_URL_PATTERNS:
        if re.search(pattern, url, re.IGNORECASE):
            return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.VIDEO, source="pattern")
    
    # Strategy 3: Extension-based detection
    # Remove query string for extension check
    clean_path = path.split('?')[0]
    ext = Path(clean_path).suffix.lower()
    
    if ext in VIDEO_EXTENSIONS:
        return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.VIDEO, extension=ext[1:], source="extension")
    
    if ext in IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
        is_animated = ext in ANIMATED_EXTENSIONS
        return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.IMAGE, extension=ext[1:], is_animated=is_animated, source="extension")
    
    # Strategy 4: Civitai-specific heuristics
    # Civitai sometimes serves videos with image extensions
    is_civitai = any(domain in parsed.netloc for domain in CIVITAI_DOMAINS)
    
    if is_civitai:
        # Check for animation indicators in query params
        if 'anim=' in query or 'transcode=' in query:
            # If anim=false, it's requesting static image
            if 'anim=false' in query:
                return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.IMAGE, source="civitai-anim-false")
            # transcode=true indicates video processing
            if 'transcode=true' in query:
                return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.VIDEO, source="civitai-transcode")
    
    # Default: assume image for web content
    return MediaInfo(type=MediaType.IMAGE, source="default")


def is_video_url(url: str) -> bool:
    """
    Quick check if URL is likely a video.
    
    Convenience function wrapping detect_media_type.
    
    Args:
        url: URL to check
        
    Returns:
        True if URL appears to be video content
    """
    info = detect_media_type(url)
    return info.type == MediaType.VIDEO


def is_image_url(url: str) -> bool:
    """
    Quick check if URL is likely an image.
    
    Args:
        url: URL to check
        
    Returns:
        True if URL appears to be image content
    """
    info = detect_media_type(url)
    return info.type == MediaType.IMAGE


# =============================================================================
# URL Transformation Functions
# =============================================================================

def get_optimized_video_url(
    url: str,
    width: int = 1080,
    format: str = 'mp4',
) -> str:
    """
    Transform video URL for optimal playback quality.
    
    For Civitai URLs, adds transcoding parameters for consistent
    MP4 output at specified quality. Non-Civitai URLs returned unchanged.
    
    Quality Levels:
    - 450: Low quality, fast loading (mobile/preview)
    - 720: HD quality (default for hover preview)
    - 1080: Full HD quality (fullscreen viewing)
    
    Args:
        url: Original video URL
        width: Target width in pixels (450, 720, 1080)
        format: Output format (currently only 'mp4' supported)
        
    Returns:
        Optimized URL with quality parameters
        
    Example:
        >>> get_optimized_video_url("https://image.civitai.com/video.mp4", 720)
        'https://image.civitai.com/video.mp4?transcode=true&width=720'
    """
    if not url:
        return url
    
    # Parse URL
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    
    # Check if Civitai URL
    is_civitai = any(domain in parsed.netloc for domain in CIVITAI_DOMAINS)
    
    if not is_civitai:
        # Return non-Civitai URLs unchanged
        return url
    
    # Parse existing query params
    params = parse_qs(parsed.query)
    
    # Add/update transcoding parameters
    params['transcode'] = ['true']
    params['width'] = [str(width)]
    
    # Rebuild URL
    new_query = urlencode(params, doseq=True)
    new_url = urlunparse((
        parsed.scheme,
        parsed.netloc,
        parsed.path,
        parsed.params,
        new_query,
        parsed.fragment
    ))
    
    return new_url


def get_video_thumbnail_url(
    url: str,
    width: int = 450,
) -> str:
    """
    Get static thumbnail URL from video URL.

    For Civitai URLs, modifies PATH parameters (not query params) to request
    a static image frame instead of animated/video content.

    Civitai URL format uses path-based parameters:
    https://image.civitai.com/.../UUID/anim=true,transcode=true,width=450/filename.jpeg

    Args:
        url: Video URL
        width: Thumbnail width (optional scaling)

    Returns:
        URL for static thumbnail image

    Example:
        >>> get_video_thumbnail_url("https://image.civitai.com/.../UUID/transcode=true/video.jpeg")
        'https://image.civitai.com/.../UUID/anim=false,transcode=true,width=450,optimized=true/video.jpeg'
    """
    if not url:
        return url

    # Parse URL
    parsed = urlparse(url)

    # Check if Civitai URL
    is_civitai = any(domain in parsed.netloc for domain in CIVITAI_DOMAINS)

    if not is_civitai:
        # Non-Civitai: try to find thumbnail by convention
        # Common pattern: video.mp4 -> video.jpg
        path = parsed.path
        for vid_ext in VIDEO_EXTENSIONS:
            if path.lower().endswith(vid_ext):
                # Try common thumbnail extensions
                return url.replace(vid_ext, '.jpg')
        return url

    # Civitai: modify PATH-based parameters (not query params!)
    # URL format: /xG1nkqKTMzGDvpLrqFT7WA/UUID/params/filename.jpeg
    path_parts = parsed.path.split('/')

    # Find path segment containing params (contains '=' like 'anim=true,transcode=true')
    param_idx = -1
    for i, part in enumerate(path_parts):
        if '=' in part or part.startswith('width'):
            param_idx = i
            break

    # Build new params string for static thumbnail
    new_params = f"anim=false,transcode=true,width={width},optimized=true"

    if param_idx >= 0:
        # Replace existing params
        path_parts[param_idx] = new_params
    elif len(path_parts) >= 3:
        # Insert params before filename
        path_parts.insert(-1, new_params)

    new_path = '/'.join(path_parts)

    # For Civitai, all params are in path - clear query string
    new_url = urlunparse((
        parsed.scheme,
        parsed.netloc,
        new_path,
        '',  # No URL params
        '',  # Clear query string - Civitai uses path-based params
        ''   # No fragment
    ))

    return new_url


def get_civitai_static_url(url: str) -> str:
    """
    Alias for get_video_thumbnail_url with Civitai focus.

    Modifies Civitai URL path to ensure static content (anim=false).
    Useful for preventing auto-play of animated content.

    Args:
        url: Any Civitai media URL

    Returns:
        URL with anim=false in path parameters
    """
    # Delegate to the main function which handles path-based params correctly
    return get_video_thumbnail_url(url, width=450)


def get_civitai_video_url(url: str, quality: int = 1080) -> str:
    """
    Alias for get_optimized_video_url with Civitai focus.
    
    Args:
        url: Civitai media URL
        quality: Video width (450, 720, 1080)
        
    Returns:
        URL with transcode=true and width parameters
    """
    return get_optimized_video_url(url, width=quality)


# =============================================================================
# Utility Functions
# =============================================================================

def extract_extension(url: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract file extension from URL.
    
    Args:
        url: URL to parse
        
    Returns:
        Extension without dot (e.g., 'mp4') or None
    """
    if not url:
        return None
    
    # Remove query string
    clean = url.split('?')[0]
    
    # Get suffix
    ext = Path(clean).suffix.lower()
    
    return ext[1:] if ext else None


def normalize_video_extension(url: str) -> str:
    """
    Ensure URL ends with proper video extension.
    
    Civitai sometimes serves videos as .jpeg - this fixes the extension
    for local storage.
    
    Args:
        url: Original URL
        
    Returns:
        URL with .mp4 extension (for Civitai) or unchanged
    """
    if not url:
        return url
    
    # Only process Civitai URLs
    if 'civitai.com' not in url:
        return url
    
    # Check if already has video extension
    for ext in VIDEO_EXTENSIONS:
        if url.lower().endswith(ext) or f"{ext}?" in url.lower():
            return url
    
    # Check if this is actually a video (by pattern)
    info = detect_media_type(url)
    if info.type != MediaType.VIDEO:
        return url
    
    # Replace extension
    for img_ext in ['.jpeg', '.jpg', '.png', '.webp']:
        if url.lower().endswith(img_ext):
            return url[:-len(img_ext)] + '.mp4'
        if f"{img_ext}?" in url.lower():
            return url.replace(img_ext, '.mp4')
    
    return url


def format_file_size(size_bytes: int) -> str:
    """
    Format bytes to human readable string.

    Args:
        size_bytes: Size in bytes

    Returns:
        Human readable size string (e.g., "5.0 MB", "2.00 GB")

    Example:
        >>> format_file_size(5 * 1024 * 1024)
        '5.0 MB'
    """
    if size_bytes < 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes} B"
    elif size_bytes < 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes / 1024:.1f} KB"
    elif size_bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size_bytes / (1024 * 1024):.1f} MB"
    else:
        return f"{size_bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024):.2f} GB"


# =============================================================================
# Testing Helpers
# =============================================================================

def _test_detection():
    """Run basic detection tests (for development)."""
    test_cases = [
        # Standard extensions
        ("https://example.com/image.jpg", MediaType.IMAGE),
        ("https://example.com/video.mp4", MediaType.VIDEO),
        ("https://example.com/animation.gif", MediaType.IMAGE),  # GIF is image
        
        # Civitai URLs
        ("https://image.civitai.com/preview.jpeg", MediaType.IMAGE),
        ("https://image.civitai.com/preview.mp4", MediaType.VIDEO),
        ("https://image.civitai.com/preview.jpeg?transcode=true", MediaType.VIDEO),
        ("https://image.civitai.com/preview.mp4?anim=false", MediaType.IMAGE),
        
        # Edge cases
        ("", MediaType.UNKNOWN),
        ("https://example.com/noextension", MediaType.IMAGE),  # Default
    ]
    
    for url, expected in test_cases:
        result = detect_media_type(url)
        status = "✓" if result.type == expected else "✗"
        print(f"{status} {url[:50]:50} -> {result.type.value} (expected {expected.value})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    _test_detection()
